title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
title_zh: 知识图谱作为文件：一种智能体框架，其中工具创建与工具使用协同进化

paragraphs.en: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI .
paragraphs.zh: 在搜索文本丰富的知识图谱时，需要一边追踪关系，一边审查文本证据。 预定义的图谱接口会限制智能体可以访问的证据，即使它们编写代码来组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图谱也是如此。 我们提出了直接知识图谱交互（DKGI），这是一种框架，语言模型智能体可以直接基于完整的节点和边文件创建图谱访问工具。 智能体会编写 Python 代码来追踪关系、合并节点集并选择文本证据，在执行过程中穿插使用 shell 搜索和文件检查。 这使得智能体能够批量处理大型节点集，同时返回选定的文本供模型评估。 执行反馈会指导工具的创建与修订，而不断演变的工具则决定了智能体接下来要收集哪些证据。 在涵盖三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的 DKGI 在所有图谱上的 Hit@1 指标均比最强的已发表基线模型高出至少 6.7 个点，即便使用最小化框架也是如此。 受控的消融实验表明，多轮编程相比仅使用 shell 访问和预定义图谱工具有明显优势，而执行轨迹显示智能体会修订代码以扩展搜索或解决错误。 这些发现凸显了在图谱搜索过程中允许工具创建与工具使用协同进化的价值。 我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI 获取。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) store entities and typed relations ( Pan et al., 2024 ) . In text-rich KGs, also known as semi-structured knowledge bases, nodes carry additional text information such as product pages, paper abstracts, or drug descriptions ( Wu et al., 2024b ) . Requests over these graphs often combine relational and textual constraints. For example, to find “papers by co-authors of X on topic Y” , a large language model (LLM) agent must locate X, identify the other authors of X’s papers, collect their papers, and check which ones address Y. The challenge is therefore to connect evidence across records while inspecting the text that supports each candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 知识图谱（KGs）存储实体和带类型的关系（Pan 等人，2024）。 在文本丰富的知识图谱中（也称为半结构化知识库），节点携带额外的文本信息，例如产品页面、论文摘要或药物描述（Wu 等人，2024b）。 对这些图谱的查询通常会结合关系约束和文本约束。 例如，要找到“X 的共同作者在 Y 主题上的论文”，大型语言模型（LLM）智能体必须定位 X，识别 X 论文的其他作者，收集他们的论文，并检查哪些论文涉及 Y。 因此，挑战在于连接不同记录中的证据，同时检查支持每个候选项的文本内容。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods typically access the graph through specialized interfaces. These interfaces include database query languages ( Li et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) , retrievers that return reasoning paths or subgraphs ( Luo et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2024 ) , and tools for entity search, node lookup, and neighbor expansion ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . Beyond direct tool use, some agents write code that combines predefined graph tool calls ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , while others generate code to traverse and process graph objects provided by a dedicated subgraph retriever ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 contrasts direct tool use (Setting ①) with these forms of code-based interaction (Setting ②). Across these designs, agents have different degrees of freedom to compute over the available data. Nevertheless, access to the underlying graph remains governed by a predefined interface . Such interfaces determine how much evidence each operation exposes and how the agent can inspect it. Figure 1 (a) illustrates this on a request for “ papers on data quality enhancement algorithms affiliated with the University of the Balearic Islands ”. A neighbors call returns only some of the institution’s affiliated researchers. The agent must choose which researchers’ papers to examine and make calls to check whether those papers satisfy the topic constraint. In the illustrated run, it never encounters the gold paper. Writing code to batch these calls can simplify this process, but each call still inherits the API’s limits on the evidence it returns.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通常通过专用接口访问图结构。 这些接口包括数据库查询语言（Li et al., 2023；Gu et al., 2023；Luo et al., 2024a）、返回推理路径或子图的检索器（Luo et al., 2024b；He et al., 2024），以及用于实体搜索、节点查找和邻居扩展的工具（Sun et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2024；Polonuer et al., 2026）。 除了直接使用工具外，一些智能体还会编写代码来组合预定义的图工具调用（Wu et al., 2024a；Jiang et al., 2025），而另一些智能体则会生成代码，以遍历并处理由专用子图检索器提供的图对象（Ding et al., 2026）。 表1对比了直接使用工具（设置①）与这些基于代码的交互形式（设置②）。 在这些不同设计中，智能体在可用数据上进行计算时所拥有的自由度各不相同。 尽管如此，对底层图结构的访问仍然受限于预定义的接口。 此类接口决定了每次操作能暴露多少证据，以及智能体如何检查这些证据。 图1（a）通过一个请求示例说明了这一点：“巴利阿里群岛大学附属的数据质量增强算法相关论文”。 一次邻居调用仅返回该机构部分附属研究人员的名单。 智能体必须选择要审查哪些研究人员的论文，并发起调用以检查这些论文是否符合主题约束。 在所示的运行过程中，它从未遇到目标论文。 编写代码将这些调用批量执行可以简化这一过程，但每次调用仍然继承API对返回证据的限制。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, we propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which agents write and revise their own code to access text-rich KGs. Inspired by the idea of direct corpus interaction over text corpora ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we expose both textual node records and typed graph relations as files, together with the graph schema. Unlike Setting ② in Table 1 , where code uses graph query languages or APIs, or operates on retrieved subgraphs, DKGI lets the agent implement graph access directly over the complete node and edge files . The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine sets of nodes, and inspect textual attributes. It freely interleaves code execution with shell search and record inspection, refining its code as new evidence becomes available. We provide the graph files, their format description, and an execution environment. The agent constructs the graph access tools that each request needs (Setting ③ in Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了直接知识图谱交互（DKGI）方法，这是一种机制，使智能体能够编写和修改自己的代码以访问富含文本的知识图谱。 受直接在文本语料库上进行语料交互的启发（Li et al., 2026），我们将文本节点记录和带类型的图谱关系一同作为文件提供，并附上图谱模式。 与表1中的设置②不同——在该设置中，代码使用图谱查询语言或API，或对检索到的子图谱进行操作——DKGI允许智能体直接基于完整的节点和边文件实现图谱访问。 智能体编写Python代码以追踪关系、合并节点集合并检查文本属性。 它能自由地将代码执行与壳搜索和记录检查交织进行，并在新证据出现时优化其代码。 我们提供图谱文件、其格式说明以及一个执行环境。 智能体构建每次请求所需的图谱访问工具（表1中的设置③）。

paragraphs.en: On the same request, DKGI writes and revises graph access code ( tool creation ) and executes it to gather evidence ( tool use ). Execution feedback guides which access operations to create or refine. The resulting code, in turn, changes how the agent explores the graph and what evidence it obtains. Tool creation and tool use thus co-evolve : the agent develops its tools as it searches, and its evolving tools guide the subsequent search (Figure 1 (b)).
paragraphs.zh: 针对同一请求，DKGI会编写和修改图访问代码（工具创建），并执行该代码以收集证据（工具使用）。 执行反馈会指导应创建或改进哪些访问操作。 由此生成的代码反过来又会改变智能体探索图的方式以及其获取的证据类型。 因此，工具创建与工具使用是协同进化的：智能体在搜索过程中不断开发工具，而不断演化的工具又会引导后续的搜索过程（图1(b)）。

sents.zh: 针对同一请求，DKGI会编写和修改图访问代码（工具创建），并执行该代码以收集证据（工具使用）。

sents.zh: 执行反馈会指导应创建或改进哪些访问操作。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DKGI as a training-free method on the three KGs (Amazon, MAG, and Prime) from the STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , using both the minimal Pi harness ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and the more feature-rich Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Even in Pi, our best DKGI configuration exceeds the strongest published baseline ( Tao et al., 2026 ) by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every dataset. Controlled ablations examine the role of agent-written graph access code. With the backbone, harness, and budgets held fixed, shell-only access trails predefined graph tools, whereas allowing the agent to write and execute Python code improves overall Hit@1 by 6.9 points and reverses this comparison. A single Python execution recovers little of this gain, supporting the value of multi-turn interaction. Analysis of trajectories further shows that agents use execution feedback to create and refine graph access code, which in turn guides further search. Tool creation and tool use thus co-evolve during graph search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 STaRK 基准测试（Wu et al., 2024b）的三个知识图谱（Amazon、MAG 和 Prime）上，将 DKGI 作为一种无需训练的方法进行评估，同时使用了最小 Pi harness（Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026）和功能更丰富的 Codex CLI（OpenAI, 2026a）。 即使在 Pi 环境中，我们最优的 DKGI 配置在每一组数据集上的 Hit@1 指标都至少比已发表的 strongest baseline（Tao et al., 2026）高出 6.7 分。 受控消融分析研究了智能体编写的图访问代码所起的作用。 在保持主干架构、harness 和预算不变的情况下，仅使用 shell 访问会遵循预定义的图工具；而允许智能体编写并执行 Python 代码则使整体 Hit@1 提升了 6.9 分，并逆转了这一比较结果。 单次 Python 执行几乎无法恢复这种性能提升，这支持了多轮交互的价值。 对轨迹的进一步分析表明，智能体会利用执行反馈来创建和优化图访问代码，而这些代码反过来又会指导后续的搜索过程。 因此，在图搜索过程中，工具创建与工具使用是协同进化的。

sents.en: We evaluate DKGI as a training-free method on the three KGs (Amazon, MAG, and Prime) from the STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , using both the minimal Pi harness ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and the more feature-rich Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 我们在 STaRK 基准测试（Wu et al., 2024b）的三个知识图谱（Amazon、MAG 和 Prime）上，将 DKGI 作为一种无需训练的方法进行评估，同时使用了最小 Pi harness（Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026）和功能更丰富的 Codex CLI（OpenAI, 2026a）。

sents.en: Even in Pi, our best DKGI configuration exceeds the strongest published baseline ( Tao et al., 2026 ) by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every dataset.
sents.zh: 即使在 Pi 环境中，我们最优的 DKGI 配置在每一组数据集上的 Hit@1 指标都至少比已发表的 strongest baseline（Tao et al., 2026）高出 6.7 分。

sents.en: Controlled ablations examine the role of agent-written graph access code.
sents.zh: 受控消融分析研究了智能体编写的图访问代码所起的作用。

sents.en: With the backbone, harness, and budgets held fixed, shell-only access trails predefined graph tools, whereas allowing the agent to write and execute Python code improves overall Hit@1 by 6.9 points and reverses this comparison.
sents.zh: 在保持主干架构、harness 和预算不变的情况下，仅使用 shell 访问会遵循预定义的图工具；而允许智能体编写并执行 Python 代码则使整体 Hit@1 提升了 6.9 分，并逆转了这一比较结果。

sents.en: A single Python execution recovers little of this gain, supporting the value of multi-turn interaction.
sents.zh: 单次 Python 执行几乎无法恢复这种性能提升，这支持了多轮交互的价值。

sents.en: Analysis of trajectories further shows that agents use execution feedback to create and refine graph access code, which in turn guides further search.
sents.zh: 对轨迹的进一步分析表明，智能体会利用执行反馈来创建和优化图访问代码，而这些代码反过来又会指导后续的搜索过程。

sents.en: Tool creation and tool use thus co-evolve during graph search.
sents.zh: 因此，在图搜索过程中，工具创建与工具使用是协同进化的。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DKGI, a harness in which agents create and refine graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DKGI，这是一种机制，其中智能体可以直接在完整的节点和边文件上创建并优化图访问工具。

paragraphs.en: We show that training-free DKGI achieves state-of-the-art performance on the STaRK benchmark using a minimal agent harness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，无需训练的 DKGI 使用一个最小的智能体框架，即可在 STaRK 基准测试中达到当前最先进的性能。

paragraphs.en: Controlled ablations and trajectory analyses show the benefits of interleaving tool creation and tool use and characterize how the two co-evolve during agent–KG interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的消融分析和轨迹研究表明，交替进行工具创建和工具使用具有优势，并描述了在智能体与知识图谱（KG）交互过程中，这两者如何协同演化。

paragraphs.en: DKGI places complete graph files in an agent harness. The harness provides an execution environment and returns observations, while the agent determines how to acquire and combine the evidence needed for each request (Figure 1 ).

The agent uses shell tools for file inspection (e.g., cat , head , sed ) and text search (e.g., grep , rg ) ( Li et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: The file layout supports both text search and code execution. Text search locates nodes by matching their attributes, while Python can extract the fields needed for further reasoning. A format description specifies the file locations and how to locate nodes by ID. Edge endpoints let code follow a relation in either direction, with the schema guiding interpretation of entity roles. The agent is directed to inspect the format description and schema at the start of a task, then decides which nodes, relations, and attributes to inspect. Appendix A documents the concrete export layout used in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 该文件布局支持文本搜索和代码执行。 文本搜索通过匹配节点属性来定位节点，而 Python 可以提取进一步推理所需的字段。 格式描述指定了文件位置以及通过 ID 定位节点的方法。 边的端点允许代码沿任一方向追踪关系，同时由模式指导对实体角色的解释。 智能体在任务开始时被引导检查格式描述和模式，然后决定要检查哪些节点、关系和属性。 附录 A 记录了我们在实验中使用的具体导出布局。

paragraphs.en: Execution provides candidate IDs, intermediate sets, empty matches, and error messages. The agent can use these observations in later turns to choose another traversal, narrow a filter, inspect a file’s structure, or revise earlier code. The revised code determines which nodes and relations subsequent executions examine. Tool creation and tool use therefore co-evolve : evidence guides the construction of access procedures, and those procedures guide further evidence gathering.
paragraphs.zh: 执行过程会提供候选 ID、中间集合、空匹配和错误消息。 智能体可以在后续回合中利用这些观察结果，选择另一种遍历方式、缩小筛选范围、检查文件结构或修改之前的代码。 修改后的代码决定了后续执行将检查哪些节点和关系。 因此，工具创建与工具使用是协同进化的：证据指导访问流程的构建，而这些流程又指导进一步的证据收集。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate DKGI in two general-purpose harnesses: the minimal Pi ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and the more feature-rich Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Pi provides a simple setting for controlled ablations of graph access and agent-written code, with the model, harness, and budgets held fixed (§ 3.3 ). Codex tests the same design with richer runtime support. Both provide read-only graph files, a format description, a schema, and a writable scratch directory. Following Li et al. (2026) , the Pi implementation supplements its bash and read tools with lightweight context management that retains code while replacing older tool results with placeholders as the context fills. We add the graph export, task prompt, output handling of § 2.4 , and an execution sandbox. In Codex, the model invokes shell commands, including Python, through JavaScript, with Codex’s own output and context management. Appendices B.1 and C document the prompts and implementation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种通用框架中实例化了 DKGI：最小化的 Pi（Zechner 和 Pi 贡献者，2026）以及功能更丰富的 Codex CLI（OpenAI，2026a）。 Pi 提供了一个简单的设置，用于对图访问和智能体编写的代码进行受控的消融研究，同时保持模型、框架和预算固定不变（§3.3）。 Codex 则通过更丰富的运行时支持来测试相同的设计。 两者都提供了只读的图文件、格式描述、模式以及一个可写入的临时目录。遵循 Li 等人 （2026）的做法，Pi 的实现在其 bash 和 read 工具的基础上补充了轻量级的上下文管理功能：在上下文逐渐填充时，保留代码，同时用占位符替换旧的工具结果。 我们增加了图导出、任务提示、输出处理（见 §2.4）以及一个执行沙箱。 在 Codex 中，模型通过 JavaScript 调用 shell 命令（包括 Python），并使用 Codex 自身的输出和上下文管理功能。 附录 B.1 和 C 记录了提示词和实现设置。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Following STaRK, we report Hit@1 (H@1, also called Hits@1), Recall@20 (R@20) and mean reciprocal rank (MRR). Because the agent is asked for 20 IDs, our MRR is a lower bound on the full-ranking MRR. A query whose attempts all fail counts as a miss in every metric (retry policy in Appendix C ). Overall values are micro-averages over all queries of the three datasets, and differences are computed before rounding. Appendix C reports the cost and resource use of each configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 遵循 STaRK，我们报告 Hit@1（H@1，也称为 Hits@1）、Recall@20（R@20）和平均倒数排名（MRR）。 由于智能体被要求提供 20 个 ID，因此我们的 MRR 是完整排序 MRR 的一个下界。 所有尝试均未成功的查询在各项指标中均计为一次未命中（重试策略见附录 C）。 总体数值是对三个数据集中所有查询的微观平均值，且差异是在四舍五入前计算的。 附录 C 报告了每种配置的成本和资源使用情况。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We report published results and, as in Table 2 , separate the systems trained or tuned on STaRK from the training-free ones. The baselines are retrievers, LLM pipelines and agents, and all of them access the KG through predefined operations. The strongest trained system, GRASP ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , combines a Cypher query on a graph database with a trained dense retriever and a fine-tuned reranker. Among the training-free systems, KAR ( Xia et al., 2025b ) and AF-Retriever ( Boer et al., 2026 ) are LLM pipelines. KAR expands the query from the documents of neighboring entities, and AF-Retriever translates it into graph constraints. The agent ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) calls predefined global search and one-hop neighborhood search tools. We list separately three KG reasoning methods (ToG, RoG and GoG) that Yang et al. (2025) adapt to STaRK and run with GPT-4. Appendix E describes every system.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型。 我们报告了已发表的结果，并且如表 2 所示，将基于 STaRK 训练或调优的系统与无需训练的系统区分开来。 基线模型包括检索器、LLM 管道和智能体，它们都通过预定义的操作访问知识图谱（KG）。 性能最强的训练系统 GRASP（Tao 等人，2026）结合了图数据库上的 Cypher 查询、一个经过训练的密集检索器和一个微调后的重排序器。 在无需训练的系统当中，KAR（Xia 等人，2025b）和 AF-Retriever（Boer 等人，2026）是 LLM 管道。 KAR 从相邻实体的文档中扩展查询，而 AF-Retriever 则将其转换为图约束。 智能体 ARK（Polonuer 等人，2026）会调用预定义的全局搜索和单跳邻域搜索工具。 我们单独列出了三种 KG 推理方法（ToG、RoG 和 GoG），这些方法由 Yang 等人 （2025）适配到 STaRK 并使用 GPT-4 运行。 附录 E 描述了每个系统。

paragraphs.en: With GPT-6-Luna, DKGI is the strongest training-free method on MAG and Prime, and with GPT-6-Astra it achieves the highest H@1 and MRR on every dataset (Table 2 ). On MAG and Prime, DKGI with GPT-6-Luna in Pi outperforms every training-free baseline in all three metrics and exceeds the best of them in H@1 by 9.4 points on MAG (AF-Retriever) and by 13.2 points on Prime (ARK). On every dataset, it also outperforms the three KG reasoning methods that Yang et al. (2025) adapt to STaRK, whose H@1 is at most 41.3.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用 GPT-6-Luna 时，DKGI 是 MAG 和 Prime 数据集上最强的免训练方法；而在使用 GPT-6-Astra 时，它在所有数据集上都实现了最高的 H@1 和 MRR（表 2）。在 MAG 和 Prime 数据集上，Pi 中基于 GPT-6-Luna 的 DKGI 在所有三项指标上均优于任何免训练基线方法，并且在 MAG 上的 H@1 比最佳方法（AF-Retriever）高出 9.4 个百分点，在 Prime 上则高出 13.2 个百分点（ARK）。此外，它在所有数据集上也优于 Yang et al. (2025) 为 STaRK 改编的三种 KG 推理方法，这些方法的 H@1 最高仅为 41.3。

paragraphs.en: As a training-free method, DKGI also outperforms the strongest trained system, GRASP, in H@1 and MRR, on MAG with GPT-6-Luna and on all three datasets with GPT-6-Astra. With GPT-6-Luna in Pi, its margins on MAG are 5.2 H@1 and 1.5 MRR points. With GPT-6-Astra in Pi, its H@1 margins over GRASP are 8.2, 9.0 and 6.7 points on Amazon, MAG and Prime, respectively. With the same prompt and harness, overall H@1 rises from 71.5 with GPT-6-Luna to 82.1 with GPT-6-Astra.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种无需训练的方法，DKGI 在 MAG 数据集上使用 GPT-6-Luna，以及在所有三个数据集上使用 GPT-6-Astra 时，其 H@1 和 MRR 表现也优于最强的训练系统 GRASP。 在 Pi 中使用 GPT-6-Luna 时，它在 MAG 上的领先幅度为 5.2 个 H@1 点和 1.5 个 MRR 点。 在 Pi 中使用 GPT-6-Astra 时，它与 GRASP 相比的 H@1 领先幅度在 Amazon、MAG 和 Prime 上分别为 8.2、9.0 和 6.7 点。 使用相同的提示词和工具链，整体 H@1 从使用 GPT-6-Luna 时的 71.5 提升至使用 GPT-6-Astra 时的 82.1。

paragraphs.en: The 2 × 2 2\times 2 design crosses graph access with Python. With predefined graph tools. The agent has four graph tools based on ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . search ranks nodes by BM25 over their names and summaries, get_node returns the record of an ID, get_schema returns the schema, and neighbors returns at most 20 one-hop neighbors of a node, with optional relation, type and keyword filters. In Graph tools, each graph access is a single call to one of these tools, as in ARK, Graph-CoT and ToG ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . In Graph tools + code, the agent writes and revises Python programs that reach the graph through client calls to the four tools. AvaTaR and KG-Agent also compose predefined tool calls in code ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . With the graph files. Full DKGI has the graph files, a shell and Python. In Shell only, the agent combines Pi’s read tool and shell commands such as rg , sed and sort with bash pipelines, loops and arithmetic, while python3 , awk , perl and node are blocked. One program restricts Full DKGI to the shell commands of Shell only and a single Python run per query, so the agent writes all of its Python operations before it sees the output of any of them. Control variants. Retrieval only removes neighbors from Graph tools, and No edges removes the edge files from Full DKGI. In the closed-book probes (Appendix F ), the model answers once from its own knowledge, with STaRK node IDs (the ID probe ) or, on MAG and Prime, with entity names mapped to IDs offline (the name probe ).
paragraphs.zh: 2 × 2 2\times 2 设计将图访问与 Python 相结合。 使用预定义的图工具。 该智能体拥有四种基于 ARK（Polonuer 等人，2026）的图工具：search 根据 BM25 对节点名称和摘要进行排名；get_node 返回某个 ID 的记录；get_schema 返回模式；neighbors 返回最多 20 个节点的一跳邻居，并支持可选的关系、类型和关键词过滤。 在“图工具”中，每次图访问都是对这些工具之一的一次调用，这与 ARK、Graph-CoT 和 ToG（Polonuer 等人，2026；Jin 等人，2024；Sun 等人，2024）的做法一致。 在“图工具 + 代码”模式中，智能体编写并修改 Python 程序，通过客户端调用这四种工具来访问图数据。 AvaTaR 和 KG-Agent 也在代码中组合预定义的工具调用（Wu 等人，2024a；Jiang 等人，2025）。使用图文件。 完整 DKGI 包含图文件、一个 shell 环境和 Python。 在“仅 Shell”模式中，智能体结合 Pi 的读取工具和 shell 命令（如 rg、sed 和 sort），并使用 bash 管道、循环和算术运算，而 python3、awk、perl 和 node 则被禁用。 一种程序将完整 DKGI 限制为“仅 Shell”模式中的 shell 命令，且每次查询仅执行一次 Python 运行，因此智能体必须在看到任何 Python 操作的结果之前，先编写所有 Python 操作。控制变体。 “仅检索”模式从图工具中移除了邻居功能，“无边”模式则从完整 DKGI 中移除了边文件。 在闭书测试（附录 F）中，模型仅基于自身知识回答一次：对于 STaRK 节点 ID（ID 测试），或对于 MAG 和 Prime，使用预先离线映射到 ID 的实体名称（名称测试）。

sents.en: The 2 × 2 2\times 2 design crosses graph access with Python.

paragraphs.en: With Python, the agent outperforms predefined graph tools in overall H@1. With the shell but no Python (Shell only), the agent scores 68.3 overall H@1, below Graph tools (72.8), and it is also lower on every dataset and in overall R@20 and MRR. It prints entire records (an Amazon product record includes all of its reviews) and follows relations by searching the edge files with rg . With Python, Full DKGI reaches 75.2, 2.4 points above Graph tools, and its MRR is also higher (78.9 vs. 77.6). The lead comes from MAG and Prime.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Python 时，该智能体在整体 H@1 指标上优于预定义图工具。 仅使用 shell 而不使用 Python（仅 Shell）时，该智能体的整体 H@1 得分为 68.3，低于图工具（72.8），并且在每个数据集以及整体 R@20 和 MRR 指标上也更低。 它会打印完整的记录（一个亚马逊产品记录包含其所有评论），并通过使用 rg 搜索边文件来追踪关系。 使用 Python 时，Full DKGI 达到了 75.2，比图工具高出 2.4 分，并且其 MRR 也更高（78.9 对比 77.6）。 这一领先优势来自 MAG 和 Prime。

paragraphs.en: Python improves the agent far more than it improves predefined graph tools. On the graph files, adding Python (Full DKGI vs. Shell only) improves overall H@1 by 6.9 points, R@20 by 8.5 and MRR by 6.9. With the graph tools, adding Python (Graph tools + code vs. Graph tools) improves overall H@1 and MRR by 1.4 points each. The tools search and neighbors already return compact entries with node IDs, names and types. On the graph files, the agent’s programs produce such entries themselves, by extracting a few fields from each node record and following relations over the edge files.
paragraphs.zh: Python 对智能体的提升远大于它对预定义图工具的提升。 在图文件上，添加 Python（Full DKGI 对比 Shell 单独使用）使整体 H@1 提升 6.9 分，R@20 提升 8.5，MRR 提升 6.9。 对于图工具，添加 Python（图工具 + 代码 对比 图工具）使整体 H@1 和 MRR 各提升 1.4 分。 工具搜索和邻居功能已经能够返回包含节点 ID、名称和类型的紧凑条目。 在图文件上，智能体的程序会自行生成此类条目，通过从每个节点记录中提取少量字段，并沿着边文件中的关系进行遍历。

paragraphs.en: The agent gains most from Python when it writes and executes programs over several turns. One program reaches 69.0 overall H@1, 0.7 points above Shell only and 6.2 below Full DKGI. A single program recovers about a tenth of the 6.9-point gain from Python on the graph files, although the agent runs its program in 81% of the queries. On the queries in which both variants run Python, this program is longer than the first program of Full DKGI (median 15 vs. 8 lines) and shorter than all programs of Full DKGI on the query together (median 41 lines). These results support the value of repeated, adaptive programming.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体在多个回合中编写并执行程序时，它能从 Python 中获得最大的收益。 其中一个程序的总体 H@1 达到了 69.0，仅比 Shell 高 0.7 分，但比 Full DKGI 低 6.2 分。 在图形文件上，单个程序大约恢复了使用 Python 所获得的 6.9 分收益中的十分之一，尽管智能体仅在 81% 的查询中运行该程序。 在两个变体都运行 Python 的查询中，这个程序比 Full DKGI 的第一个程序更长（中位数分别为 15 行和 8 行），但在所有查询中，它又比 Full DKGI 的所有程序都短（中位数为 41 行）。 这些结果支持了重复、适应性编程的价值。

paragraphs.en: Full DKGI achieves higher overall H@1 than predefined graph tools composed in code. Full DKGI is 1.0 point above Graph tools + code in overall H@1 (75.2 vs. 74.2), and the two are equal in MRR (78.9). On MAG and Prime together, its H@1 is 80.0, compared with 76.7 for Graph tools and 78.4 for Graph tools + code. Unlike both tool variants, it needs no predefined graph API and works on the exported graph files.
paragraphs.zh: Full DKGI 的整体 H@1 高于通过代码组合的预定义图工具。 Full DKGI 的整体 H@1 比“图工具 + 代码”高出 1.0 分（75.2 对比 74.2），而两者的 MRR 相同（均为 78.9）。 在 MAG 和 Prime 数据集上，其 H@1 为 80.0，而“图工具”为 76.7，“图工具 + 代码”为 78.4。 与这两种工具变体不同，它无需任何预定义的图 API，并且可以直接在导出的图文件上运行。

sents.en: Full DKGI achieves higher overall H@1 than predefined graph tools composed in code.
sents.zh: Full DKGI 的整体 H@1 高于通过代码组合的预定义图工具。

sents.en: Full DKGI is 1.0 point above Graph tools + code in overall H@1 (75.2 vs. 74.2), and the two are equal in MRR (78.9).
sents.zh: Full DKGI 的整体 H@1 比“图工具 + 代码”高出 1.0 分（75.2 对比 74.2），而两者的 MRR 相同（均为 78.9）。

sents.en: On MAG and Prime together, its H@1 is 80.0, compared with 76.7 for Graph tools and 78.4 for Graph tools + code.
sents.zh: 在 MAG 和 Prime 数据集上，其 H@1 为 80.0，而“图工具”为 76.7，“图工具 + 代码”为 78.4。

sents.en: Unlike both tool variants, it needs no predefined graph API and works on the exported graph files.
sents.zh: 与这两种工具变体不同，它无需任何预定义的图 API，并且可以直接在导出的图文件上运行。

paragraphs.en: The agent relies on the relations in the graph. Removing access to the relations lowers accuracy sharply, mostly on MAG and Prime. No edges reaches 44.2 overall H@1, 31.0 points below Full DKGI, and Retrieval only reaches 47.7, 25.1 points below Graph tools. The ID probe shows little recall of benchmark IDs. On the full test sets, the ID probe answers one Prime query correctly, and the name probe answers 2.3% of MAG and 20.9% of Prime queries correctly. On the 223 test-subset Prime queries that the name probe misses, the lead of Full DKGI over Graph tools is 4.0 points (63.2 vs. 59.2), compared with 3.2 points on all Prime queries of the test subset.

paragraphs.en: Section 3.3 shows that the agent gains most from Python when it writes and executes programs over several turns. We trace this process in the 7,108 trajectories of Full DKGI with GPT-6-Luna on the full test sets (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.3 节表明，当智能体在多个回合中编写并执行程序时，它能从 Python 中获得最大的收益。 我们在 Full DKGI 使用 GPT-6-Luna 在完整测试集上生成的 7,108 条轨迹中追踪了这一过程（图 2）。

sents.en: Section 3.3 shows that the agent gains most from Python when it writes and executes programs over several turns.
sents.zh: 第 3.3 节表明，当智能体在多个回合中编写并执行程序时，它能从 Python 中获得最大的收益。

sents.en: We trace this process in the 7,108 trajectories of Full DKGI with GPT-6-Luna on the full test sets (Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 我们在 Full DKGI 使用 GPT-6-Luna 在完整测试集上生成的 7,108 条轨迹中追踪了这一过程（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: The agent searches first and then writes programs. A trajectory starts with file reads and rg searches, and Python makes up 8.2% of the calls between 20% and 40% of a trajectory and 83.3% of the calls in its last 20% (Figure 2 a). The agent writes 4.0 programs per query on average. Of all programs, 75.0% contain a full node scan and 35.5% a one-hop traversal. In 42.3% of the queries, a program contains scoring or ranking, a multi-hop traversal or a set operation (Figure 2 b). The two operation types in blue have counterparts among the predefined graph tools, as neighbors performs a one-hop traversal and get_node looks up a node by its ID.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体先进行搜索，然后编写程序。 一条轨迹始于文件读取和 rg 搜索；在轨迹的 20% 到 40% 区间内，Python 占调用总数的 8.2%，而在最后 20% 的区间中，其调用占比高达 83.3%（图 2a）。 智能体每次查询平均编写 4.0 个程序。 在所有程序中，75.0% 包含完整的节点扫描，35.5% 包含单跳遍历。 在 42.3% 的查询中，程序包含评分或排序、多跳遍历或集合操作（图 2b）。 蓝色标注的两种操作类型在预定义的图工具中均有对应功能：neighbors 执行单跳遍历，而 get_node 通过节点 ID 查找节点。

paragraphs.en: Programs reuse IDs from earlier outputs and code from earlier programs. Of all programs, 48.4% contain a node ID shown in the output of an earlier turn, and almost all of these programs check the IDs (48.0% of all programs, Figure 2 b). In the request of Figure 1 , two rg searches return the IDs of the university and of the field Data quality , and the agent’s programs take these IDs as input to collect the 236 papers of the university’s 66 authors and intersect them with the 86 papers of the field. Programs also reuse the code of earlier programs. Of all programs, 36.5% revise an earlier one under our similarity criterion (Appendix G ). After a program fails, the next program revises it in 88.6% of cases, and after a program runs successfully, the next program revises it in 49.7% of cases. In this way, the agent’s tools evolve from one another within a task. One program, which allows a single program per query, removes this process and recovers a tenth of the gain from Python (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 程序会复用早期输出中的 ID 以及早期程序中的代码。 在所有程序中，48.4% 的程序包含一个出现在先前回合输出中的节点 ID，且其中几乎所有程序都会对这些 ID 进行检查（占所有程序的 48.0%，见图 2b）。 在图 1 的请求中，两次 rg 搜索返回了大学和“数据质量”领域的 ID，智能体的程序将这些 ID 作为输入，收集该大学 66 位作者的 236 篇论文，并将其与该领域的 86 篇论文进行交集运算。 程序也会复用早期程序的代码。 在所有程序中，有 36.5% 的程序根据我们的相似性标准对早期程序进行了修改（见附录 G）。 当一个程序失败后，在 88.6% 的情况下，下一个程序会对其进行修改；而当某个程序成功运行后，在 49.7% 的情况下，下一个程序也会对其进行修改。 通过这种方式，智能体的工具会在同一任务中相互演化。 其中一个程序（每个查询仅允许一个程序运行）移除了这一过程，并恢复了十分之一的 Python 带来的增益（见第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The agent’s lead over predefined graph tools is largest on queries where both tool-based agents make many calls. On the 100 test-subset queries for which both Graph tools and Graph tools + code call neighbors at least ten times, Full DKGI leads them by 9.0 and 6.0 H@1 points, compared with 1.3 and 0.2 points on the other 610 queries. These 100 queries all come from MAG and Prime, and 85.0% of them have a program with scoring or ranking, a multi-hop traversal or a set operation, compared with 37.5% of the other queries. The request of Figure 1 is one of these 100 queries. The Graph tools agent misses its gold paper, which Full DKGI ranks first (Appendix I compares the two agents on two more requests).
paragraphs.zh: 在那些基于工具的智能体都需要进行多次调用的查询中，该智能体相对于预定义图工具的领先优势最大。 在 100 条测试子集查询中，这些查询要求图工具和“图工具 + 代码”智能体至少调用邻居十次，Full DKGI 分别比它们高出 9.0 和 6.0 个 H@1 分数，而在其余 610 条查询中，这一差距仅为 1.3 和 0.2 分。 这 100 条查询全部来自 MAG 和 Prime，其中 85.0% 的查询包含评分或排名程序、多跳遍历或集合操作，而其他查询中仅有 37.5% 具备这些特征。 图 1 中的请求就是这 100 条查询之一。 图工具智能体未能找到其黄金论文，而 Full DKGI 则将其排在首位（附录 I 比较了这两种智能体在另外两个请求上的表现）。

paragraphs.en: With a stronger LLM, the agent reuses earlier outputs more often and revises more of its failed programs. With GPT-6-Astra, the agent turns to programs earlier (Python makes up 31.4% of the calls between 20% and 40% of a trajectory, compared with 8.2%), 59.9% of its programs contain an ID from an earlier output (compared with 48.4%), and the next program revises a failed one in 92.2% of cases (compared with 88.6%). With GPT-6-Luna in Codex, the last two shares are 50.3% and 85.1%, close to those in Pi (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 借助更强大的 LLM，智能体更频繁地复用早期输出，并对更多失败的程序进行修订。 使用 GPT-6-Astra 时，智能体更早地转向已有程序（在轨迹的 20% 到 40% 区间内，Python 调用占比为 31.4%，而此前为 8.2%），59.9% 的程序包含来自早期输出的 ID（此前为 48.4%），并且在 92.2% 的情况下，后续程序会修订失败程序（此前为 88.6%）。 在 Codex 中使用 GPT-6-Luna 时，后两项比例分别为 50.3% 和 85.1%，与 Pi 中的数值相近（附录 G）。

sents.en: With a stronger LLM, the agent reuses earlier outputs more often and revises more of its failed programs.
sents.zh: 借助更强大的 LLM，智能体更频繁地复用早期输出，并对更多失败的程序进行修订。

paragraphs.en: Ranking is the largest source of remaining errors. Among the queries that Full DKGI answers incorrectly, a gold node is returned but ranked below the first position in 58%, 46% and 55% on Amazon, MAG and Prime, and search misses account for 41%, 23% and 37% (Figure 2 c).
paragraphs.zh: 排名是剩余错误的最大来源。 在 Full DKGI 回答错误的查询中，虽然返回了金节点，但在 Amazon、MAG 和 Prime 上，该节点分别有 58%、46% 和 55% 的情况排在首位之后；此外，搜索未命中分别占到了 41%、23% 和 37%（图 2c）。

paragraphs.en: Direct tool use. Retrieve-then-reason methods ( Jiang et al., 2023b ; Luo et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ; Mavromatis and Karypis, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) retrieve reasoning paths or subgraphs from the KG and reason over them. In KG agents such as ToG ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) , the LLM steers a predefined beam search over entities and relations, and StructGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) , Graph-CoT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , GoG ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and Plan-on-Graph ( Chen et al., 2024a ) give it other sets of predefined graph functions. GRA ( Dragic et al., 2026 ) explores hybrid KGs through seven predefined Unix-style tools such as ls , cat and grep .
paragraphs.zh: 直接工具使用。 “检索-推理”方法（Jiang 等，2023b；Luo 等，2024b；Kim 等，2023；He 等，2024；Mavromatis 和 Karypis，2025；Li 等，2025b）从知识图谱中检索推理路径或子图，并基于这些路径或子图进行推理。 在 ToG（Sun 等，2024；Ma 等，2025）等知识图谱智能体中，大语言模型引导对实体和关系进行预定义的束搜索；而 StructGPT（Jiang 等，2023a）、Graph-CoT（Jin 等，2024）、GoG（Xu 等，2024）和 Plan-on-Graph（Chen 等，2024a）则为其提供了其他预定义的图函数集合。 GRA（Dragic 等，2026）通过七个预定义的类 Unix 工具（如 ls、cat 和 grep）探索混合知识图谱。

sents.en: Direct tool use.
sents.zh: 直接工具使用。

sents.en: Retrieve-then-reason methods ( Jiang et al., 2023b ; Luo et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ; Mavromatis and Karypis, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) retrieve reasoning paths or subgraphs from the KG and reason over them.
sents.zh: “检索-推理”方法（Jiang 等，2023b；Luo 等，2024b；Kim 等，2023；He 等，2024；Mavromatis 和 Karypis，2025；Li 等，2025b）从知识图谱中检索推理路径或子图，并基于这些路径或子图进行推理。

sents.en: In KG agents such as ToG ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) , the LLM steers a predefined beam search over entities and relations, and StructGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) , Graph-CoT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , GoG ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and Plan-on-Graph ( Chen et al., 2024a ) give it other sets of predefined graph functions.
sents.zh: 在 ToG（Sun 等，2024；Ma 等，2025）等知识图谱智能体中，大语言模型引导对实体和关系进行预定义的束搜索；而 StructGPT（Jiang 等，2023a）、Graph-CoT（Jin 等，2024）、GoG（Xu 等，2024）和 Plan-on-Graph（Chen 等，2024a）则为其提供了其他预定义的图函数集合。

sents.en: GRA ( Dragic et al., 2026 ) explores hybrid KGs through seven predefined Unix-style tools such as ls , cat and grep .
sents.zh: GRA（Dragic 等，2026）通过七个预定义的类 Unix 工具（如 ls、cat 和 grep）探索混合知识图谱。

paragraphs.en: Code over a graph interface. Semantic parsing maps a question to SPARQL, an S-expression or a program executed on the KG ( Liang et al., 2017 ; Cao et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) , and Xiong et al. (2024) build these logical forms interactively through knowledge-base APIs. KG-Agent ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a small model to generate programs that call predefined tools. Code-on-Graph ( Ding et al., 2026 ) represents the schema as Python classes and generates code that processes graph objects provided by a subgraph retriever. On STaRK, AvaTaR ( Wu et al., 2024a ) optimizes the prompt of an agent that composes predefined functions in Python.
paragraphs.zh: 在图接口上编写代码。 语义解析将问题映射到 SPARQL、S-表达式或在知识图谱上执行的程序（Liang et al., 2017; Cao et al., 2022; Li et al., 2023; Gu et al., 2023; Luo et al., 2024a），以及 Xiong et al. （2024）通过知识图谱 API 交互式地构建这些逻辑形式。 KG-Agent（Jiang et al., 2025）对一个小模型进行微调，以生成调用预定义工具的程序。 Code-on-Graph（Ding et al., 2026）将模式表示为 Python 类，并生成处理由子图检索器提供的图对象的代码。 在 STaRK 上，AvaTaR（Wu et al., 2024a）优化了一个智能体的提示，该智能体用 Python 组合预定义函数。

paragraphs.en: Agents that create their own tools. Outside KGs, CodeAct agents ( Wang et al., 2024a ) act through executable Python, and other methods create tools as code ( Cai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wölflein et al., 2025 ) . CREATOR ( Qian et al., 2023 ) , Self-Debug ( Chen et al., 2024b ) and PyVision ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) refine code using execution feedback. Live-SWE-agent ( Xia et al., 2025a ) creates tools within a minimal bash scaffold to solve software issues. SMITH ( Tam et al., 2026 ) jointly trains tool creation and use with reinforcement learning and reuses tools across tasks, whereas DKGI is training-free and creates and revises tools within a task. Graph-as-Code ( Finkelshtein et al., 2026 ) iteratively writes and executes code over a table of node features, neighbor lists and labels for node classification. For entity search over typed, multi-relational KGs, DKGI is to our knowledge the first harness that lets agents implement graph operations over complete node and edge files.
paragraphs.zh: 能够自行创建工具的智能体。 在知识图谱外部，CodeAct 智能体（Wang 等人，2024a）通过可执行的 Python 代码进行行动，而其他方法则通过生成代码来创建工具（Cai 等人，2024；Yuan 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2024b；Wölflein 等人，2025）。 CREATOR（Qian 等人，2023）、Self-Debug（Chen 等人，2024b）和 PyVision（Zhao 等人，2025）利用执行反馈来优化代码。 Live-SWE-agent（Xia 等人，2025a）在最小的 bash 框架内创建工具以解决软件问题。 SMITH（Tam 等人，2026）通过强化学习联合训练工具创建与使用能力，并可在不同任务中复用工具；而 DKGI 无需训练，且能在单个任务内创建和修改工具。 Graph-as-Code（Finkelshtein 等人，2026）通过对节点特征表、邻居列表和标签进行迭代编码与执行，实现节点分类。 在针对带类型、多关系知识图谱的实体搜索方面，据我们所知，DKGI 是首个能让智能体对完整的节点和边文件执行图操作的工具。

paragraphs.en: We presented DKGI, a harness where LLM agents write and execute their own graph access code over the complete node and edge files. With GPT-6-Astra, the training-free DKGI achieves the highest H@1 and MRR on every STaRK dataset. In controlled ablations with GPT-6-Luna, the agent achieves higher overall H@1 than predefined graph tools, whether called directly or composed in code, and it gains most when it writes and revises programs over several turns. Its trajectories show how tool creation and tool use co-evolve within a task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DKGI，这是一种机制，其中 LLM 智能体能够编写并执行针对完整节点和边文件的图访问代码。 借助 GPT-6-Astra，无需训练的 DKGI 在每一个 STaRK 数据集上都实现了最高的 H@1 和 MRR。 在基于 GPT-6-Luna 的受控消融实验中，无论智能体是直接调用预定义图工具还是在代码中组合使用，其整体 H@1 均更高；当它在多个回合中编写并修订程序时，效果提升最为显著。 其执行轨迹展示了工具创建与工具使用如何在任务中协同演化。

sents.zh: 其执行轨迹展示了工具创建与工具使用如何在任务中协同演化。

paragraphs.en: Scope. Our evaluation covers the three text-rich KGs of STaRK, which have at most 10 entity types, 18 relation types, 1.9M entities and 39.8M edges ( Wu et al., 2024b ) . Other KG benchmarks such as WebQSP, CWQ or GrailQA ( Yih et al., 2016 ; Talmor and Berant, 2018 ; Gu et al., 2021 ) , graphs with Freebase- or Wikidata-scale schemas, aggregation questions and the scaling of DKGI with graph size are left to future work. Where a KG is too large to scan or a question needs exact aggregation, purpose-built indexes, graph databases and query languages may be more suitable, and an agent could write its graph operations on top of them. A comparison with an agent in the same harness that queries a graph database through a query language such as Cypher or SPARQL ( Feng et al., 2025 ) is also left to future work. GraphRAFT, which fine-tunes a text-to-Cypher model, enters the comparison through its published numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 范围。 我们的评估涵盖了 STaRK 这三个文本丰富的知识图谱，它们最多包含 10 种实体类型、18 种关系类型、190 万个实体和 3980 万条边（Wu et al., 2024b）。 其他知识图谱基准数据集，如 WebQSP、CWQ 或 GrailQA（Yih et al., 2016；Talmor and Berant, 2018；Gu et al., 2021）、具有 Freebase 或 Wikidata 规模模式的知识图谱、聚合问题以及 DKGI 随知识图谱规模变化的情况，均留待未来研究。 如果某个知识图谱过大而无法扫描，或者问题需要精确的聚合操作，那么专门设计的索引、图数据库和查询语言可能更为适用，智能体也可以在其之上编写图操作。 与同一测试框架中通过 Cypher 或 SPARQL 等查询语言访问图数据库的智能体进行比较，也留待未来研究（Feng et al., 2025）。 GraphRAFT 通过对文本到 Cypher 模型进行微调，借助其已发表的实验结果进入本次比较。

paragraphs.en: Models, baselines and data. Our main results use the proprietary models GPT-6-Luna and GPT-6-Astra, which we accessed through an API in September and October 2026. Exact reproduction depends on the continued availability of these models. Open-weight models remain to be tested. We release the code under the MIT License and the exported graphs, prompts and all trajectories under CC BY 4.0. Baseline numbers are taken from the literature and were obtained with different backbones, budgets and evaluation code. The ablations in § 3.3 hold these factors fixed. Our evaluation uses STaRK’s synthetic queries, which make up most of the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 模型、基线模型和数据。 我们的主要结果使用了专有模型 GPT-6-Luna 和 GPT-6-Astra，我们于 2026 年 9 月和 10 月通过 API 获取了这些模型。 能否完全复现取决于这些模型能否持续可用。 开放权重的模型仍有待测试。 我们将代码以 MIT 许可证发布，并将导出的图、提示词和所有轨迹以 CC BY 4.0 许可证发布。 基线模型的数值来自文献，并使用不同的基础模型、预算和评估代码获得。 § 3.3 中的消融研究在这些因素保持不变的情况下进行。 我们的评估使用了 STaRK 的合成查询，这些查询构成了基准测试的大部分内容。

paragraphs.en: We use the public STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , whose data are released under CC BY 4.0. The code of STaRK, DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) , the Pi coding agent and ARK is released under the MIT License, and Codex CLI under the Apache License 2.0. Our research use of these artifacts is consistent with their licenses, and our derived data keep STaRK’s CC BY 4.0 license. The code, exported graphs, prompts and trajectories that we release are intended for research on agents that search knowledge graphs. STaRK’s queries are in English, as are almost all node records. The Amazon data contain user reviews, and the MAG data contain author names and affiliations. These public data are part of the benchmark. We use them as provided by STaRK, and all personal data in this work come from the benchmark. Because the agent can execute arbitrary shell commands, we ran it in a sandbox that keeps the graph files read-only and blocks access to the network and the labels (Appendix C ). We report point estimates from one evaluation per configuration and query set, with failed attempts retried as described in Appendix C . Appendix C gives the computational cost. The Amazon and Prime text-constraint tags in Appendix G were assigned by an LLM annotator, GPT-6-Luna. We used AI assistants for coding and for writing assistance.

paragraphs.en: We export each of the three STaRK knowledge graphs once from the graph data released with the benchmark (Hugging Face dataset snap-stanford/stark , revision 88269e2 ), using a script that makes no model calls. For Amazon, we use the default graph, which includes brand, category and color nodes. STaRK built these graphs from Amazon product reviews and metadata ( He and McAuley, 2016 ; McAuley et al., 2015 ) together with Amazon question-answer data ( McAuley and Yang, 2016 ) , from the Microsoft Academic Graph ( Sinha et al., 2015 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) through the OGB datasets ogbn-mag and ogbn-papers100M ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , and from PrimeKG ( Chandak et al., 2023 ) . Each exported graph consists of four parts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个不调用任何模型的脚本，从基准测试中发布的图数据（Hugging Face数据集 snap-stanford/stark，版本 88269e2）中分别导出这三个 STaRK 知识图谱中的每一个。 对于 Amazon，我们使用默认图谱，其中包含品牌、类别和颜色节点。 STaRK 通过 OGB 数据集 ogbn-mag 和 ogbn-papers100M（Hu et al., 2020）以及 PrimeKG（Chandak et al., 2023），结合 Amazon 产品评论和元数据（He and McAuley, 2016；McAuley et al., 2015）、Amazon 问答数据（McAuley and Yang, 2016）以及 Microsoft Academic Graph（Sinha et al., 2015；Wang et al., 2020），构建这些图谱。 每个导出的图谱由四个部分组成。

sents.zh: 对于 Amazon，我们使用默认图谱，其中包含品牌、类别和颜色节点。

sents.en: STaRK built these graphs from Amazon product reviews and metadata ( He and McAuley, 2016 ; McAuley et al., 2015 ) together with Amazon question-answer data ( McAuley and Yang, 2016 ) , from the Microsoft Academic Graph ( Sinha et al., 2015 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) through the OGB datasets ogbn-mag and ogbn-papers100M ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , and from PrimeKG ( Chandak et al., 2023 ) .

paragraphs.en: Node files. Each node is stored as one JSON line with four fields: node_id (the benchmark ID, which is also the answer ID), node_type , is_candidate and attributes . The attributes field contains all source attributes of the node unchanged, except that non-finite numbers are written as null . Nodes are stored in ID order in shards of 10,000 nodes each ( nodes/NNNN.jsonl ).
paragraphs.zh: 节点文件。 每个节点都存储为一条 JSON 记录，包含四个字段：node_id（基准测试 ID，同时也是答案 ID）、node_type、is_candidate 和 attributes。 attributes 字段包含该节点的所有原始属性且保持不变，但非有限数会被写为 null。 节点按 ID 顺序存储在分片中，每个分片包含 10,000 个节点（nodes/NNNN.jsonl）。

paragraphs.en: What the export preserves. The exported graphs keep all nodes, including the evidence nodes outside the candidate set (for example, brands in Amazon and authors in MAG), with all their attributes, every stored edge row and the type labels. The export is a plain-text copy of the released graph, with the node types, relation types and attribute fields of the release, and predictions are scored directly on the benchmark IDs. After exporting, the script checks that the node files contain every node exactly once and in ID order, and that 100 randomly chosen records per dataset read back identical to the source. Queries and gold answers are kept in files outside the agent’s sandbox. Table 4 gives the sizes of the exported graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 导出内容所保留的信息。 导出的图保留了所有节点，包括候选集之外的证据节点（例如 Amazon 中的品牌和 MAG 中的作者），以及它们的所有属性、每个存储的边行和类型标签。 该导出文件是已发布图的纯文本副本，包含发布版本中的节点类型、关系类型和属性字段，预测结果则直接根据基准测试 ID 进行评分。 导出后，脚本会检查节点文件是否恰好包含每个节点一次且按 ID 排序，并验证每个数据集随机选取的 100 条记录是否与源数据完全一致。 查询和标准答案被保存在智能体沙盒之外的文件中。 表 4 列出了所导出图的大小。

paragraphs.en: The name probe, run on MAG and Prime, replaces the three lines after “The query may have several correct answers.” with three lines that ask for names: “Return the <name kind> of the correct answers.” , the same ranking line with “20 unique names” in place of “20 unique integer IDs” , and the same JSON line with the structure {"names": ["...", "..."]} . <KB description> names the knowledge base (for example, “the STaRK-MAG academic knowledge base built from the Microsoft Academic Graph” ), and <answer types> names the candidate types: products, papers, or the ten node types of Prime. <name kind> is “exact paper titles” for MAG and “exact entity names as used in PrimeKG” for Prime.
paragraphs.zh: 名为 probe 的机制在 MAG 和 Prime 上运行，它将“该查询可能有多个正确答案。”之后的三行代码替换为要求返回名称的三行代码：“返回正确答案的 <name kind>。”、将“20 个唯一整数 ID”替换为“20 个唯一名称”的相同排序行，以及结构为 {"names": ["...", "..."]} 的相同 JSON 行。<KB description> 指代知识库（例如，“基于 Microsoft Academic Graph 构建的 STaRK-MAG 学术知识库”），而 <answer types> 指代候选类型：产品、论文或 Prime 的十种节点类型。<name kind> 对于 MAG 是“精确的论文标题”，而对于 Prime 则是“PrimeKG 中使用的精确实体名称”。

paragraphs.en: All prompt decisions were made on STaRK validation queries with GPT-6-Luna in both harnesses, without using any test query, test trajectory or test label. A prompt-selection round compared ranking instructions and tool instructions. In its tool-instruction comparison on the same 450 queries (150 per dataset) for both prompts, the rg prompt reduced the share of shell commands that run Python from 47% to 5% with Codex and from 51% to 1.5% with Pi, relative to the prompt with the same ranking instruction and our tool instruction. With Codex, the share of queries in which the agent ran any Python fell from 98% to 12%. Input tokens rose by about 110k per query with both harnesses. We then revised the ranking instruction once, which produced the final prompt. On 750 further validation queries (300 from Amazon, 300 from MAG and 150 from Prime), we compared it with a base prompt whose ranking instruction allows up to 100 IDs and whose other text is the same. Overall R@20 rose from 61.9 to 71.3 with Pi and from 57.6 to 68.8 with Codex, and overall H@1 changed by − 2.3 -2.3 and − 0.8 -0.8 points, respectively. The prompt was fixed before any test result was seen.
paragraphs.zh: 所有提示词决策均基于 STaRK 验证查询，在两种工具包中均使用 GPT-6-Luna 作出，且未使用任何测试查询、测试轨迹或测试标签。 一轮提示词选择环节比较了排序指令与工具指令。 在对相同 450 条查询（每个数据集 150 条）的同一两种提示词进行工具指令比较时，rg 提示词使运行 Python 的 shell 命令比例从 47% 降至 5%（Codex），以及从 51% 降至 1.5%（Pi），相较于使用相同排序指令和我们工具指令的提示词。 在 Codex 中，智能体运行任何 Python 代码的查询比例从 98% 降至 12%。 两种工具包中，每条查询的输入令牌数均增加了约 11 万个。 随后我们对排序指令进行了一次修订，从而形成了最终提示词。 在另外 750 条验证查询（Amazon 300 条、MAG 300 条和 Prime 150 条）上，我们将该提示词与一个基础提示词进行了比较：后者允许最多 100 个 ID 的排序指令，其余文本则相同。 整体 R@20 在 Pi 下从 61.9 提升至 71.3，在 Codex 下从 57.6 提升至 68.8；整体 H@1 分别变化了 −2.3 和 −0.8 个百分点。 在查看任何测试结果之前，提示词已被固定。

paragraphs.en: All runs of a configuration use the same harness, and each query has its own scratch directory. The agent writes its programs inline in its commands, and they are discarded after each query. All runs that we conducted, including the validation runs and the closed-book probes, used GPT-6-Luna or GPT-6-Astra through an API in September and October 2026.

paragraphs.en: Pi. We use DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) at upstream commit 271f37e (1 June 2026). DCI-Agent-Lite builds on the Pi coding agent ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) , 1 1 1 https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono using a fork of Pi version 0.65.0 to which it adds runtime context management. We use both as released. Our three small changes to DCI-Agent-Lite’s runner script are in our code release. The one that affects scoring reads the final answer from the last assistant message, so that an attempt that ends with a tool call or an error counts as failed. Pi runs in its offline mode with two tools, read and bash , and with its default system prompt, which lists the available tools and gives the date and the working directory. Its skills, prompt templates, themes and extensions are disabled, except for the extension that registers the graph tools. The model is GPT-6-Luna (GPT-6-Astra for the stronger-backbone rows) with reasoning effort high , a context window of 272,000 tokens and at most 32,000 output tokens per request. For context management, we use level 3 of DCI-Agent-Lite, the lightweight setting that it uses for its own benchmarks, which truncates large tool outputs and compacts the history by replacing older tool results with a placeholder. Each attempt may take at most 300 turns and 1,800 s of wall-clock time. Head-and-tail truncation, described below, is our one change to how Pi returns tool outputs.
paragraphs.zh: Pi。 我们在上游提交 271f37e（2026 年 6 月 1 日）中使用了 DCI-Agent-Lite（Li 等人，2026）。 DCI-Agent-Lite 基于 Pi 编码智能体（Zechner 和 Pi 贡献者，2026），1 1 1 https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono，它使用 Pi 版本 0.65.0 的一个分支，并为其增加了运行时上下文管理。我们使用的是两者的发布版本。 我们对 DCI-Agent-Lite 运行脚本所做的三项小改动包含在我们的代码发布中。 影响评分的那项改动会从最后一个助手消息中读取最终答案，因此以工具调用或错误结尾的尝试将被计为失败。 Pi 以离线模式运行，配备 read 和 bash 两种工具，并使用其默认的系统提示，其中列出了可用工具并提供了日期和工作目录。 除了用于注册图工具的那个扩展外，其技能、提示模板、主题和扩展均被禁用。 该模型为 GPT-6-Luna（对于更强主干的行列则使用 GPT-6-Astra），推理强度设为高，上下文窗口为 272,000 个词元，每次请求最多输出 32,000 个词元。 在上下文管理方面，我们使用了 DCI-Agent-Lite 的第 3 级，即其自身基准测试中使用的轻量级设置，该设置会截断较长的工具输出，并通过用占位符替换较早的工具结果来压缩历史对话。 每次尝试最多可执行 300 轮操作，且总实际运行时间不得超过 1,800 秒。 下文描述的“头尾截断”是我们对 Pi 返回工具输出方式所做的唯一改动。

paragraphs.en: Codex CLI. Full DKGI (Codex) runs the codex exec command of Codex CLI 0.156.1 2 2 2 https://github.com/openai/codex with the same model, reasoning effort and context window as Pi, and its budget is Pi’s time limit per attempt. User configuration, rules and project documents are ignored, sessions are ephemeral, and approval is never requested. Web search, network access and optional features such as multi-agent use, memory, plugins and browser use are disabled. Codex’s own system prompt and tool are used unchanged. With this tool, the model writes short JavaScript programs, each of which can run several shell commands in one call. Codex keeps its own output truncation, which lets the model raise the limit for an individual call, and we apply head-and-tail truncation in Pi.
paragraphs.zh: Codex CLI。 完整的 DKGI（Codex）运行 Codex CLI 0.156.1 2 2 2 https://github.com/openai/codex 的 codex exec 命令，使用与 Pi 相同的模型、推理力度和上下文窗口，其预算为 Pi 每次尝试的时间限制。 用户配置、规则和项目文档均被忽略，会话是临时的，且从不请求批准。 网络搜索、网络访问以及多智能体使用、记忆、插件和浏览器使用等可选功能均已禁用。 Codex 自身的系统提示和工具均按原样使用。 借助该工具，模型可以编写简短的 JavaScript 程序，每个程序在一次调用中即可运行多个 shell 命令。 Codex 保留其自身的输出截断机制，这使得模型能够提高单次调用的限制，而我们在 Pi 中应用了头部和尾部截断。

paragraphs.en: Sandbox. Both harnesses run in the same outer sandbox, a deny-by-default Landlock policy under which system libraries, the harness code and the working directory are read-only. The working directory is the graph directory or, for the graph-tool variants, a directory that holds a single README file. The writable paths are an installation-ID file of Codex and the run directory of the query, which holds the scratch directory, the logs and a per-query home directory. In Pi, shell commands run in a second sandbox layer with a clean environment, a second Landlock policy and a seccomp filter that blocks network sockets. In Codex, they run in Codex’s own sandbox with network access disabled. Only the harness process itself connects to the model endpoint, and no variant has a web-search tool. Before the model is first called, a check inside the sandbox confirms that the working directory is read-only and that the query and label files, the original benchmark files and the user’s home configuration are unreadable. The scoring process reads the labels after the agent has finished.
paragraphs.zh: 沙盒。 两个 harness 都在同一个外部沙盒中运行，该沙盒采用“默认拒绝”的 Landlock 策略，系统库、harness 代码和工作目录均为只读。 工作目录是图目录；对于 graph-tool 变体，则是一个仅包含一个 README 文件的目录。 可写路径包括 Codex 的安装 ID 文件以及查询的运行目录，后者包含临时目录、日志和每个查询专用的主目录。 在 Pi 中，shell 命令在第二层沙盒中运行，该层具有干净的环境、第二个 Landlock 策略以及一个阻止网络套接字的 seccomp 过滤器。 在 Codex 中，它们在 Codex 自己的沙盒中运行，且网络访问已禁用。 只有 harness 进程本身会连接到模型端点，并且没有任何变体具备网页搜索工具。 在首次调用模型之前，沙盒内部会进行一项检查，确认工作目录为只读，并且查询文件、标签文件、原始基准文件以及用户的主配置文件均不可读。 评分过程在智能体完成操作后读取标签。

paragraphs.en: Head-and-tail truncation. In every Pi variant with a shell, Pi’s bash tool runs its commands through a wrapper that implements the head-and-tail truncation of § 2.4 . The wrapper saves the complete output of every command in <scratch dir>/full_outputs/ , where the agent’s later commands can read it. An output of at most 18,000 bytes and 1,800 lines is returned as it is. For a longer output, the wrapper returns the first 9,000 bytes or 900 lines, whichever limit is reached first, then a notice on a separate line, and then the last 9,000 bytes or 900 lines. The notice reads:
paragraphs.zh: 头尾截断。 在每个带有外壳的 Pi 变体中，Pi 的 bash 工具会通过一个包装器执行其命令，该包装器实现了 § 2.4 中的头尾截断功能。 该包装器会将每个命令的完整输出保存到 <scratch dir>/full_outputs/ 目录下，以便智能体后续的命令可以读取这些内容。 输出长度最多为 18,000 字节或 1,800 行时，将原样返回。 对于更长的输出，包装器将首先返回前 9,000 字节或前 900 行（以先达到的限制为准），然后在一行中显示通知，最后再返回后 9,000 字节或后 900 行。该通知内容为：

sents.en: Head-and-tail truncation.
sents.zh: 头尾截断。

sents.en: In every Pi variant with a shell, Pi’s bash tool runs its commands through a wrapper that implements the head-and-tail truncation of § 2.4 .
sents.zh: 在每个带有外壳的 Pi 变体中，Pi 的 bash 工具会通过一个包装器执行其命令，该包装器实现了 § 2.4 中的头尾截断功能。

sents.en: The wrapper saves the complete output of every command in <scratch dir>/full_outputs/ , where the agent’s later commands can read it.
sents.zh: 该包装器会将每个命令的完整输出保存到 <scratch dir>/full_outputs/ 目录下，以便智能体后续的命令可以读取这些内容。

sents.en: An output of at most 18,000 bytes and 1,800 lines is returned as it is.
sents.zh: 输出长度最多为 18,000 字节或 1,800 行时，将原样返回。

sents.en: For a longer output, the wrapper returns the first 9,000 bytes or 900 lines, whichever limit is reached first, then a notice on a separate line, and then the last 9,000 bytes or 900 lines. The notice reads:
sents.zh: 对于更长的输出，包装器将首先返回前 9,000 字节或前 900 行（以先达到的限制为准），然后在一行中显示通知，最后再返回后 9,000 字节或后 900 行。该通知内容为：

paragraphs.en: The command’s exit status is preserved. A truncated output stays below the 50 KB limit of Pi’s bash tool and the 20,000-character limit of DCI-Agent-Lite’s context management, so the model receives both of its ends together with the notice. The read tool keeps Pi’s limits (2,000 lines or 50 KB per call) and the 20,000-character limit of context management.
paragraphs.zh: 命令的退出状态被保留。 截断后的输出保持在 Pi 的 bash 工具的 50 KB 限制和 DCI-Agent-Lite 上下文管理的 20,000 字符限制以内，因此模型会同时接收到输出的两端以及通知。 读取工具保留了 Pi 的限制（每次调用 2,000 行或 50 KB）以及上下文管理的 20,000 字符限制。

sents.en: The command’s exit status is preserved.
sents.zh: 命令的退出状态被保留。

sents.en: A truncated output stays below the 50 KB limit of Pi’s bash tool and the 20,000-character limit of DCI-Agent-Lite’s context management, so the model receives both of its ends together with the notice.
sents.zh: 截断后的输出保持在 Pi 的 bash 工具的 50 KB 限制和 DCI-Agent-Lite 上下文管理的 20,000 字符限制以内，因此模型会同时接收到输出的两端以及通知。

sents.en: The read tool keeps Pi’s limits (2,000 lines or 50 KB per call) and the 20,000-character limit of context management.
sents.zh: 读取工具保留了 Pi 的限制（每次调用 2,000 行或 50 KB）以及上下文管理的 20,000 字符限制。

paragraphs.en: Graph tools. Graph tools, Retrieval only and Graph tools + code access the graph through the tools in Table 5 . The tools are based on those of ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . The search and neighbors tools call ARK’s released implementations of its global search and one-hop neighborhood search, which run on ARK’s prepared graph (BM25 over ARK’s node names and summaries), and get_node and get_schema return a node record and the schema file of our graph export. The agent, the prompt and the step budget come from our harness. The tools are served by a process outside the sandbox, and the graph files also stay outside it. In Graph tools and Retrieval only, the tools are registered in Pi as native function-calling tools with the descriptions in Table 5 , and Pi’s built-in tools are disabled, so every action of the agent is a graph-tool call. In Graph tools + code, the agent has Pi’s read and bash tools and calls the same four tools from Python through a client whose methods take the same arguments and return the same text. On the test subset, Graph tools + code made an average of 45.1 graph-tool calls per query within 6.8 bash calls, compared with 18.4 tool calls per query for Graph tools.
paragraphs.zh: 图工具。 图工具、仅检索以及图工具 + 代码通过表 5 中的工具访问该图。 这些工具基于 ARK 的工具（Polonuer 等人，2026）。 搜索和邻居工具调用 ARK 已发布的其全局搜索和单跳邻域搜索的实现，这些实现运行在 ARK 准备好的图上（基于 ARK 节点名称和摘要的 BM25），而 get_node 和 get_schema 返回我们图导出的节点记录模式和模式文件。 智能体、提示词和步骤预算来自我们的框架。 这些工具由沙盒外的一个进程提供服务，图文件也保留在沙盒之外。 在图工具和仅检索中，这些工具在 Pi 中被注册为本地函数调用工具，并带有表 5 中的描述，同时 Pi 的内置工具被禁用，因此智能体的每个操作都是对图工具的调用。 在图工具 + 代码中，智能体拥有 Pi 的读取和 bash 工具，并通过一个客户端从 Python 调用相同的四个工具，该客户端的方法接受相同的参数并返回相同的文本。 在测试子集上，图工具 + 代码每次查询平均发出 45.1 次图工具调用，且 bash 调用次数为 6.8 次，而图工具每次查询的平均工具调用次数为 18.4 次。

paragraphs.en: Shell only. The shell can start a fixed list of 15 programs ( rg , cat , sed , head , tail , wc , cut , sort , comm , ls , find , pwd , xargs , echo and bash ). A Landlock execute rule enforces this list, also for find -exec and xargs . Before each query, a check confirms that these programs run and that starting python3 , awk , perl or node fails, testing python3 also through its absolute path, find -exec , xargs and the dynamic loader. Pipelines, bash loops, arrays and arithmetic remain available, and grep , awk and jq are unavailable. The graph directory is a hard-link copy of the graph export, and its DATA_FORMAT.txt omits the last line. Pi’s read tool and head-and-tail truncation are as in Full DKGI.
paragraphs.zh: 仅限 shell。 该 shell 可以启动一个包含 15 个程序的固定列表（rg、cat、sed、head、tail、wc、cut、sort、comm、ls、find、pwd、xargs、echo 和 bash）。 一条 Landlock 执行规则强制执行此列表，也适用于 find -exec 和 xargs。 每次查询前，系统会进行检查，确认这些程序可以运行，而启动 python3、awk、perl 或 node 则会失败；同时也会通过其绝对路径、find -exec、xargs 和动态加载器测试 python3。 管道、bash 循环、数组和算术运算仍然可用，而 grep、awk 和 jq 则不可用。 图目录是图导出内容的硬链接副本，且其 DATA_FORMAT.txt 缺少最后一行。 Pi 的读取工具以及 head 和 tail 的截断功能与完整 DKGI 中的相同。

sents.zh: 仅限 shell。

paragraphs.en: One program. The shell can start the 15 programs of Shell only under the same Landlock rules, as well as python3 , which has a budget of one start per attempt. The python3 command on the agent’s path is a launcher that requests each start from the process that runs the query, which keeps the count outside the sandbox. Every further start, including one from within the running program, is refused with exit status 126 and the fixed message python3: unavailable: Python 3 can be started only once in this task. A check before each query confirms this behavior, and the count is then reset. One program differs from Full DKGI in the single Python invocation, one added prompt line (Appendix B.1 ) and the programs that the shell can start, and is identical in all other respects. On the test subset, Full DKGI ran awk in 21 of its 5,866 shell commands, spread over 14 queries, and all its other interpreter runs were Python. With One program, 573 of the 710 queries used their single Python invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 单一程序。 在相同的 Landlock 规则下，外壳才能启动 Shell 的 15 个程序，以及预算为每次尝试启动一次的 python3。 智能体路径上的 python3 命令是一个启动器，它会向执行查询的进程请求每次启动，该进程将计数保留在沙盒之外。 所有后续的启动（包括从运行中的程序内部发起的启动）都将被拒绝，返回退出状态 126 和固定信息：python3: 不可用：在此任务中只能启动一次 Python 3。 每次查询前都会进行一次检查以确认此行为，然后计数会被重置。 单一程序与完整 DKGI 的不同之处在于：Python 的调用次数为一次、增加了一条提示行（附录 B.1），以及外壳可以启动的程序；其他所有方面均完全相同。 在测试子集中，完整 DKGI 在其 5,866 个外壳命令中运行了 awk 21 次，分布在 14 次查询中，而其他所有解释器运行均为 Python。 在单一程序中，710 次查询中有 573 次使用了其单次 Python 调用。

paragraphs.en: No edges. The graph directory holds hard links to the node shards and to candidate_ids.txt , a schema.json from which the relation types, the edge counts and the note on graph semantics are removed, and a DATA_FORMAT.txt shortened by its four lines about edges. Node records are unchanged, so information that the source also stores as attribute text (for example, an Amazon product’s brand and category names) is still visible. Of the graph data, the sandboxes of Shell only and No edges can each read their own graph directory.
paragraphs.zh: 无边。 图目录包含指向节点分片的硬链接，以及 candidate_ids.txt、schema.json（其中已移除关系类型、边数量及关于图语义的说明），还有 DATA_FORMAT.txt（已删减其关于边的四行内容）。 节点记录未作更改，因此源数据中以属性文本形式存储的信息（例如亚马逊产品的品牌和类别名称）仍然可见。 在图数据中，Shell only 和 No edges 的沙箱各自可以读取自己的图目录。

sents.zh: 无边。

paragraphs.en: Scoring. The agent’s final message must be a JSON object with the single key node_ids and a list of at most 100 entries, and any other output counts as a failed attempt. Entries are scored in order, and an entry that is a non-integer, a non-candidate ID or a repeat keeps its position and counts as a miss. H@1 is 1 if the first entry is a gold answer. R@20 is the number of gold answers among the first 20 entries divided by the number of gold answers. MRR is the reciprocal rank of the first gold answer among the first 100 entries, and a list whose entries are all incorrect counts as a miss. Five runs on the test sets returned 21 IDs, one more than the 20 requested, and each of them has an incorrect answer at rank 21, so every reported MRR equals MRR over the first 20 entries. An attempt that ended in a provider error, at the time limit or with output other than the requested JSON was retried, and every query of a test configuration needed at most three attempts. Metrics are averaged over all queries of a set, and a query whose attempts all failed counts as a miss in every metric. In the test configurations, this occurred for one Amazon query of One program, whose three attempts all reached the time limit.
paragraphs.zh: 评分。 智能体的最终消息必须是一个 JSON 对象，其中仅包含键 node_ids 和最多 100 个条目的列表；任何其他输出均视为尝试失败。 条目按顺序评分；若某条目为非整数、非候选 ID 或重复项，则保留其位置并计为未命中。 如果第一个条目是黄金答案，则 H@1 的值为 1。 R@20 是指前 20 个条目中黄金答案的数量除以黄金答案总数。 MRR 是前 100 个条目中第一个黄金答案的倒数排名；如果列表中所有条目均不正确，则计为未命中。 在测试集上进行的五次运行返回了 21 个 ID，比要求的 20 个多一个，且每个 ID 的第 21 位都是错误答案，因此所有报告的 MRR 都等于前 20 个条目的 MRR。 因提供商错误、达到时间限制或输出非请求 JSON 而终止的尝试会被重试，且每个测试配置的每次查询最多需要三次尝试。 各项指标基于某个集合中所有查询的平均值计算；如果某次查询的所有尝试均失败，则在该项指标中计为未命中。 在测试配置中，这种情况出现在“一个程序”的某条 Amazon 查询上，其三次尝试均达到了时间限制。

paragraphs.en: Cost. Table 6 gives the cost and resource use of each configuration at official API prices. Per million input, cached input and output tokens, GPT-6-Luna costs $0.10, $0.01 and $0.50, respectively, and GPT-6-Astra costs $10, $1 and $50. The full test run of Full DKGI with GPT-6-Astra cost about $3,000 in total. Costs are computed from the recorded token usage, which is missing for some failed attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 表 6 列出了在官方 API 价格下每种配置的成本和资源使用情况。 每百万个输入、缓存的输入和输出令牌，GPT-6-Luna 的成本分别为 0.10 美元、0.01 美元和 0.50 美元，而 GPT-6-Astra 的成本则为 10 美元、1 美元和 50 美元。 使用 GPT-6-Astra 对 Full DKGI 进行完整测试的总成本约为 3,000 美元。 成本是根据记录下来的令牌使用量计算的，但部分失败尝试中缺少该数据。

sents.en: Cost.
sents.zh: 成本。

paragraphs.en: AvaTaR ( Wu et al., 2024a ) is an LLM agent that scores candidate nodes with a Python program. The program is built from a library of predefined knowledge-base functions, which retrieve documents, embeddings and relations, compute similarity scores or ask an LLM to check a requirement. During optimization, a comparator LLM contrasts training queries on which the agent performs well with those on which it performs poorly and writes new instructions for the agent. The optimized program is applied directly to the test queries. We report its main results with Claude 3 Opus from Table 2 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: AvaTaR（Wu 等人，2024a）是一种 LLM 智能体，它通过一个 Python 程序对候选节点进行评分。 该程序由一个预定义知识库函数库构建而成，这些函数可以检索文档、嵌入和关系，计算相似度得分，或请求 LLM 检查某个要求。 在优化过程中，一个对比 LLM 会将智能体表现良好的训练查询与表现较差的查询进行对比，并为智能体编写新的指令。 优化后的程序会直接应用于测试查询。 我们从论文中的表 2 报告了使用 Claude 3 Opus 获得的主要结果。

sents.zh: AvaTaR（Wu 等人，2024a）是一种 LLM 智能体，它通过一个 Python 程序对候选节点进行评分。

paragraphs.en: PASemiQA ( Yang et al., 2025 ) separates planning from traversal. Its Llama 2-7B planner is fine-tuned to predict the shortest relation paths from the topic nodes of a query to its answers. A GPT-4 agent, guided by the predicted paths, takes actions that expand a node to its most relevant neighbors, retrieve nodes by embedding similarity and return the answer. We report its H@1 and MRR from Tables 2 and 10 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: PASemiQA（Yang 等人，2025）将规划与遍历分离。 其 Llama 2-7B 规划器经过微调，用于预测从查询的话题节点到答案的最短关系路径。 一个 GPT-4 智能体在预测路径的引导下执行操作：将某个节点扩展至其最相关的邻近节点，通过嵌入相似度检索节点，并返回答案。 我们在论文中的表 2 和表 10 中报告了其 H@1 和 MRR 指标。

sents.zh: PASemiQA（Yang 等人，2025）将规划与遍历分离。

sents.en: We report its H@1 and MRR from Tables 2 and 10 of the paper.
sents.zh: 我们在论文中的表 2 和表 10 中报告了其 H@1 和 MRR 指标。

paragraphs.en: mFAR ( Li et al., 2025a ) is a trained retriever that represents each node by one field per property or relation. On MAG and Prime, these fields also include entities up to two hops away. mFAR scores every field with BM25 and a Contriever encoder and combines the scores with query-conditioned softmax weights. The encoder and the weights are trained on the STaRK training queries. The All+2 configuration scores both a single-document and a multi-field representation. We report it from Table 1 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: mFAR（Li et al., 2025a）是一种训练好的检索器，它通过每个属性或关系对应一个字段来表示每个节点。 在 MAG 和 Prime 上，这些字段还包括最多两个跳点范围内的实体。mFAR 使用 BM25 和 Contriever 编码器对每个字段进行评分，并通过查询条件化的 softmax 权重将这些评分组合起来。 编码器和权重是在 STaRK 训练查询上进行训练的。 All+2 配置会对单文档表示和多字段表示同时进行评分。 我们在论文的表 1 中报告了这一结果。

sents.zh: mFAR（Li et al., 2025a）是一种训练好的检索器，它通过每个属性或关系对应一个字段来表示每个节点。

paragraphs.en: MoR ( Lei et al., 2025 ) mixes structural and textual retrieval. A Llama 3.2-3B planner, fine-tuned on 1,000 sampled training queries with LLM-generated planning graphs, outlines the entities that a query involves and the relations between them. A layer-wise traversal follows this plan and at each layer merges the neighbors of the planned node type with textual matches, which come from BM25 on Amazon and MAG and from a fine-tuned Contriever on Prime. A trained reranker then scores each candidate from features of the trajectory that reached it (the node types along the path, whether each step was structural or textual and the text similarity of each node) and from the candidate’s ada-002 similarity to the query. We report the MoR row from Table 1 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: MoR（Lei 等人，2025）结合了结构检索与文本检索。 一个在 1,000 条采样训练查询和 LLM 生成的规划图上微调的 Llama 3.2-3B 规划器，会概述查询所涉及的实体及其之间的关系。 随后进行逐层遍历，遵循该规划方案，并在每一层将规划节点类型的邻接节点与文本匹配结果合并；这些文本匹配结果分别来自基于 Amazon 和 MAG 的 BM25，以及基于 Prime 的微调 Contriever。 接着，一个训练好的重排序器会根据到达每个候选项的路径特征（路径上的节点类型、每一步是结构检索还是文本检索，以及每个节点的文本相似度）和该候选项与查询的 ada-002 相似度进行评分。 我们报告了论文中表 1 的 MoR 行结果。

sents.zh: MoR（Lei 等人，2025）结合了结构检索与文本检索。

paragraphs.en: GraphRAFT ( Clemedtson and Shi, 2025 ) stores the KG in a Neo4j graph database and retrieves answers in three stages. GPT-4o-mini identifies the entities in the query, and a name without an exact match is resolved to its most similar nodes through a vector index over ada-002 node embeddings. A text-to-Cypher model then generates Cypher queries whose decoding is restricted to the schema-valid multi-hop queries around the identified entities, and the most probable queries are executed until the retrieved subgraph reaches a size limit. A Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct model then reads the textualized subgraph and selects and orders the answers. The text-to-Cypher model starts from Neo4j’s Gemma 2-9B text2cypher checkpoint, and both models are fine-tuned with LoRA on MAG and Prime. We report the full system from Table 1 of the paper, which covers these two datasets.
paragraphs.zh: GraphRAFT（Clemedtson 和 Shi，2025）将知识图谱存储在 Neo4j 图数据库中，并分三个阶段获取答案。 GPT-4o-mini 会识别查询中的实体；若某个名称没有完全匹配项，则通过基于 ada-002 节点嵌入的向量索引，将其解析为最相似的节点。 随后，一个文本转 Cypher 模型会生成 Cypher 查询，其解码过程被限制在已识别实体周围的、符合模式定义的跨多跳查询中；最可能的查询会被持续执行，直到检索出的子图达到大小限制。 接着，一个 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct 模型会读取文本化的子图，并挑选与排序答案。 该文本转 Cypher 模型基于 Neo4j 的 Gemma 2-9B text2cypher 检查点启动，且两个模型均通过 LoRA 在 MAG 和 Prime 数据集上进行了微调。 我们报告了论文表 1 中完整的系统，该系统涵盖了这两个数据集。

paragraphs.en: GRASP ( Tao et al., 2026 ) is a three-stage retrieval pipeline. A prompted Qwen3-27B-Instruct planner writes a JSON plan of anchors, hops and a target, which is compiled into one Cypher query on Neo4j. The resulting candidates are rescored with Qwen3-Embedding-4B on Amazon and MAG and with SapBERT on Prime. Their ranking is then fused with that of a trained mFAR retriever under a weight that can depend on the plan. Finally, a Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B, fine-tuned with LoRA on the STaRK training queries, reranks the top 100 candidates of the fused ranking, and its output is fused with that ranking once more. The fusion weights are tuned on the validation queries, and the Prime planner prompt contains 19 STaRK training queries with hand-curated plans. We report the full system, listed as supervised GRASP in Table 1 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: GRASP（Tao 等人，2026）是一个三阶段的信息检索流程。 一个通过提示调用的 Qwen3-27B-Instruct 规划器会生成一个包含锚点、跳转步骤和目标的 JSON 计划，该计划随后被编译为 Neo4j 上的单条 Cypher 查询。 生成的候选项会在 Amazon 和 MAG 上使用 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 重新评分，在 Prime 上则使用 SapBERT 重新评分。 接着，它们的排名会与一个经过训练的 mFAR 检索器的排名进行融合，融合权重可以依赖于具体计划。 最后，一个通过 LoRA 在 STaRK 训练查询上微调的 Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B 会对融合排名中的前 100 个候选项进行重新排序，其输出结果会再次与该排名进行融合。 融合权重是在验证查询上进行调整的，而 Prime 规划器的提示则包含了 19 条带有人工精选计划的 STaRK 训练查询。 我们在论文表 1 中列出的完整系统即为“监督式 GRASP”。

paragraphs.en: BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) , ColBERTv2 ( Santhanam et al., 2022 ) and GritLM-7B ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) are lexical, late-interaction and LLM-based embedding retrievers that Wu et al. (2024b) evaluate on the candidate node documents of each KG. BM25 scores a document by the frequency of the query terms in it, adjusted for term rarity and document length, and ColBERTv2 matches token-level embeddings of the query against those of each document. GritLM-7B embeds the query and the documents with a 7B LLM trained for both embedding and generation and ranks the documents by similarity. We report their results on the full test sets from Table 6 of the STaRK paper.
paragraphs.zh: BM25（Robertson 和 Zaragoza，2009）、ColBERTv2（Santhanam 等，2022）以及 GritLM-7B（Muennighoff 等，2025）分别是基于词汇、晚期交互和大型语言模型（LLM）的嵌入检索器，Wu 等（2024b）在各自知识图谱（KG）的候选节点文档上对这些方法进行了评估。BM25 通过计算查询术语在文档中的出现频率来为文档打分，并考虑了术语稀有性和文档长度的影响；ColBERTv2 则将查询的词汇级嵌入与每个文档的嵌入进行匹配；GritLM-7B 则使用一个同时经过嵌入和生成任务训练的大型语言模型（7B LLM）对查询和文档进行嵌入，并根据相似性对文档进行排序。我们报告了这些方法在 STaRK 论文表 6 中完整测试集上的结果。

paragraphs.en: KAR ( Xia et al., 2025b ) expands the query with an LLM before dense retrieval. It retrieves the documents of the entities mentioned in the query and collects their neighbors up to two hops away. For each entity, it keeps the ten neighbors whose documents are most similar to the query. GPT-4o writes query expansions from the resulting document triples, and ada-002 embeddings match the expanded query against the node documents. We report this configuration from Table 2 of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: KAR（Xia 等人，2025b）在密集检索前使用 LLM 对查询进行扩展。 它会检索查询中提及实体的文档，并收集这些实体最多两跳范围内的邻近节点。 对于每个实体，它会保留其文档与查询最相似的十个邻近节点。 GPT-4o 根据生成的文档三元组编写查询扩展，而 ada-002 嵌入则用于将扩展后的查询与节点文档进行匹配。 我们在论文中的表 2 报告了此配置。

sents.zh: KAR（Xia 等人，2025b）在密集检索前使用 LLM 对查询进行扩展。

sents.en: It retrieves the documents of the entities mentioned in the query and collects their neighbors up to two hops away.
sents.zh: 它会检索查询中提及实体的文档，并收集这些实体最多两跳范围内的邻近节点。

paragraphs.en: HybGRAG ( Lee et al., 2025 ) is an LLM agent that routes each query to a text retriever or a hybrid retriever and refines the routing with a critic. An LLM router identifies the topic entities and the relevant relations. The hybrid retriever then follows these relations within the ego-graphs of the entities and ranks the documents it reaches by vector similarity to the query. An LLM validator checks the top results, and an LLM commenter returns corrective feedback to the router for at most four iterations. The examples in its prompts come from the STaRK training set. We report its main configuration with Claude 3 Sonnet and ada-002 embeddings from Table 5 of the paper, which covers MAG and Prime.
paragraphs.zh: HybGRAG（Lee 等人，2025）是一种 LLM 智能体，它会将每个查询路由到文本检索器或混合检索器，并通过一个评论者优化路由决策。 一个 LLM 路由器会识别主题实体和相关关系。 随后，混合检索器会在这些实体的自我图内沿这些关系进行检索，并根据与查询的向量相似度对检索到的文档进行排序。 一个 LLM 验证器会检查排名靠前的结果，而一个 LLM 评论者则最多通过四次迭代向路由器返回纠正性反馈。 其提示词中的示例来自 STaRK 训练集。 我们报告了其主要配置：使用 Claude 3 Sonnet 模型以及论文表 5 中来自 MAG 和 Prime 的 ada-002 嵌入。

paragraphs.en: AF-Retriever ( Boer et al., 2026 ) is an eight-step LLM pipeline that combines graph constraints with vector similarity search. The LLM writes a Cypher query. On Prime, where answers can have several node types, it first predicts the target node type. The query is parsed into relational triples and attribute constraints, which are grounded on the graph by embedding search and set intersection. Vector search fills about two thirds of the 20 final candidates from the grounded set and the rest from unconstrained candidates of the target type, and the LLM reranks these 20 pairwise. We report its zero-shot configuration with gpt-oss-120B and text-embedding-3-small. Its H@1 and MRR come from Table 3 of the paper, and its R@20 comes from the complete-pipeline row of the ablation table (Table 5).
paragraphs.zh: AF-Retriever（Boer 等人，2026）是一个包含八个步骤的大型语言模型（LLM）流程，它将图约束与向量相似度搜索相结合。 LLM 会编写一个 Cypher 查询。 在 Prime 平台上，由于答案可能包含多种节点类型，该流程首先预测目标节点类型。 该查询被解析为关系三元组和属性约束，并通过嵌入搜索和集合交集操作将其与图数据关联起来。 向量搜索从已关联的集合中选出约三分之二的最终 20 个候选项，其余部分则来自目标类型的未约束候选项，随后 LLM 对这 20 个候选项进行两两重排序。 我们报告了其使用 gpt-oss-120B 和 text-embedding-3-small 的零样本配置结果。 其 H@1 和 MRR 指标来自论文中的表 3，而 R@20 指标则来自消融分析表（表 5）中完整流程行的数据。

paragraphs.en: ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) is an LLM agent that calls two predefined tools. A global search ranks node texts with BM25, and a one-hop neighborhood search can filter the neighbors of a node by node and edge type and rank them by a subquery. Three agents run in parallel for at most 20 steps each, and the nodes they select are fused by vote count. We report its GPT-5.2 results from Table 5 in the appendix of the paper. Our graph tools call ARK’s implementations of these two tools (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: ARK（Polonuer 等人，2026）是一个调用两个预定义工具的 LLM 智能体。 全局搜索使用 BM25 对节点文本进行排序，而单跳邻域搜索则可以根据节点和边的类型筛选节点的邻居，并通过子查询对其进行排序。 三个智能体并行运行，每个最多运行 20 步，它们所选的节点通过投票数进行融合。 我们在论文附录的表 5 中报告了其使用 GPT-5.2 的结果。 我们的图工具调用了 ARK 对这两个工具的实现（附录 C）。

sents.zh: ARK（Polonuer 等人，2026）是一个调用两个预定义工具的 LLM 智能体。

paragraphs.en: Yang et al. (2025) adapt three KG reasoning methods to STaRK and run them with GPT-4. We report their H@1 and MRR from Tables 2 and 10 of that paper.
paragraphs.zh: Yang 等人 (2025) 将三种知识图谱推理方法适配到 STaRK，并使用 GPT-4 运行这些方法。 我们从该论文的表 2 和表 10 中报告了它们的 H@1 和 MRR。

sents.en: Yang et al.
sents.zh: Yang 等人

sents.zh: (2025) 将三种知识图谱推理方法适配到 STaRK，并使用 GPT-4 运行这些方法。

paragraphs.en: ToG ( Sun et al., 2024 ) runs an LLM-guided beam search on the KG that alternates relation and entity exploration and stops once the LLM judges the retained reasoning paths sufficient or the search reaches a maximum depth.
paragraphs.zh: ToG（Sun 等人，2024）在知识图谱上执行一种由大型语言模型引导的束搜索算法，该算法交替探索关系和实体，并在大型语言模型判断保留的推理路径足够或搜索达到最大深度时停止。

paragraphs.en: RoG ( Luo et al., 2024b ) generates relation paths grounded in the KG as plans, retrieves the reasoning paths that follow these plans and lets the LLM reason over them. In its original form, RoG’s planner is Llama 2-Chat-7B instruction-tuned on WebQSP and CWQ ( Yih et al., 2016 ; Talmor and Berant, 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: RoG（Luo 等人，2024b）生成基于知识图谱的关系路径作为计划，检索遵循这些计划的推理路径，并让大型语言模型对其进行分析推理。 在原始形式中，RoG 的规划器是 Llama 2-Chat-7B，该模型在 WebQSP 和 CWQ（Yih 等人，2016；Talmor 和 Berant，2018）上进行了指令微调。

sents.en: RoG ( Luo et al., 2024b ) generates relation paths grounded in the KG as plans, retrieves the reasoning paths that follow these plans and lets the LLM reason over them.
sents.zh: RoG（Luo 等人，2024b）生成基于知识图谱的关系路径作为计划，检索遵循这些计划的推理路径，并让大型语言模型对其进行分析推理。

paragraphs.en: GoG ( Xu et al., 2024 ) is a training-free KG agent that interleaves thinking, searching and generation steps, in which the LLM proposes new triples from its own knowledge and verifies them.
paragraphs.zh: GoG（Xu 等人，2024）是一种无需训练的 KG 智能体，它将思考、搜索和生成步骤交替进行，其中 LLM 会基于自身知识提出新的三元组并进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The closed-book probes measure how many queries the model answers from its parametric knowledge alone (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 闭卷测试衡量模型仅凭其参数化知识能够回答多少查询（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Design. Both probes run GPT-6-Luna in Pi with reasoning effort high , and the model answers in a single closed-book turn (prompts in Appendix B ). The ID probe asks for up to 20 STaRK node IDs, ranked by confidence, and is run on the full test sets of all three datasets (7,108 queries). Since node IDs are arbitrary integers, a correct ID could indicate that the model has memorized benchmark files. The name probe asks for up to 20 answer names (exact paper titles for MAG and exact PrimeKG entity names for Prime), which we map to node IDs offline. Because Amazon product titles are long and rarely match exactly, it is run on the full MAG and Prime test sets (5,466 queries). The 12,574 probe runs cost $8.31 in total, and the 4 runs that failed count as wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 设计。 两个探针都在 Pi 中运行 GPT-6-Luna，并设置高推理强度，模型以单次闭卷方式作答（提示见附录 B）。 ID 探针要求提供最多 20 个 STaRK 节点 ID，按置信度排序，并在所有三个数据集的完整测试集上运行（共 7,108 次查询）。 由于节点 ID 是任意整数，正确的 ID 可能表明模型记住了基准测试文件。 名称探针要求提供最多 20 个答案名称（MAG 的准确论文标题和 Prime 的准确 PrimeKG 实体名称），我们会离线将其映射到节点 ID。 由于亚马逊产品标题较长且很少完全匹配，该探针在完整的 MAG 和 Prime 测试集上运行（共 5,466 次查询）。 12,574 次探针运行总成本为 8.31 美元，其中 4 次运行失败，计为错误。

paragraphs.en: Name mapping. The mapping uses the exported node files. MAG papers are indexed under their title and OriginalTitle , and Prime nodes under their name , details.name and every entry of details.alias . After the same normalization of indexed and returned names (NFKC, case folding, non-alphanumeric characters replaced with spaces), a returned name maps to every node indexed under the same normalized name. A query counts as answered at rank r r if the r r -th returned name maps to at least one gold node.
paragraphs.zh: 名称映射。 该映射使用导出的节点文件。 MAG 论文按标题和 OriginalTitle 进行索引，而 Prime 节点则按名称、details.name 以及 details.alias 中的每个条目进行索引。 在对索引名称和返回名称执行相同的规范化处理（NFKC、大小写折叠、将非字母数字字符替换为空格）之后，一个返回的名称会映射到所有以相同规范化名称进行索引的节点。 如果第 r 个返回的名称至少映射到一个标准节点，则查询在排名 r 处被视为已回答。

paragraphs.en: Results. The ID probe answers 0 of 1,642 Amazon, 0 of 2,665 MAG and 1 of 2,801 Prime queries correctly (H@1 of 0.00, 0.00 and 0.04%). Among all returned IDs (up to 20 per query), a gold ID appears for 1 Amazon and 4 Prime queries. The name probe obtains an H@1 of 2.3% on MAG (61 of 2,665) and 20.9% on Prime (585 of 2,801). Table 8 splits the queries by whether the name probe answers them. On the queries that the name probe answers incorrectly, Full DKGI achieves an H@1 of 88.4 on MAG and 56.9 on Prime. On the 223 Prime queries of the test subset that the name probe answers incorrectly, the variants with access to the relations achieve between 55.6 and 63.2, while Retrieval only and No edges achieve 28.7 and 28.3, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 ID探针在1,642个Amazon查询中正确回答了0个，在2,665个MAG查询中正确回答了0个，在2,801个Prime查询中正确回答了1个（H@1分别为0.00%、0.00%和0.04%）。 在所有返回的ID中（每个查询最多返回20个），有1个Amazon查询和4个Prime查询出现了黄金ID。 名称探针在MAG上获得了2.3%的H@1（2,665个查询中正确回答了61个），在Prime上获得了20.9%的H@1（2,801个查询中正确回答了585个）。 表8根据名称探针是否回答正确，对查询进行了分类。 在名称探针回答错误的查询中，Full DKGI在MAG上实现了88.4%的H@1，在Prime上实现了56.9%的H@1。 在测试子集中名称探针回答错误的223个Prime查询中，能够访问关系的变体模型实现了55.6%至63.2%的性能，而仅使用检索和无边的模型分别实现了28.7%和28.3%的性能。

paragraphs.en: Programs, calls and turns. A program is the inline Python code passed to the shell in one call, either as the argument of python3 -c or as a here-document read by python3 . There are 28,582 / 28,726 programs, and 6,832 / 6,862 queries contain at least one. A turn is the set of calls issued in one model response. Because all calls in a turn are issued before the model sees any of their outputs, “earlier” and “next” refer to turns. The agent writes and runs all its code inline in its shell commands.
paragraphs.zh: 程序、调用与回合。 程序是指通过一次调用传递给外壳的嵌入式 Python 代码，可以是作为 python3 -c 的参数，也可以是 python3 读取的 here-document。 共有 28,582 / 28,726 个程序，其中 6,832 / 6,862 条查询至少包含一个程序。 回合是指一次模型响应中发出的调用集合。 由于回合中的所有调用在模型看到任何输出之前都已发出，因此“较早”和“下一个”指的是回合。 智能体在其外壳命令中直接编写并运行所有代码。
