paragraphs.en: Command intents and trajectory segments. We assign every shell command to one of the nine categories that Li et al. (2026) use for DCI-Agent-Lite, with a rule-based classifier that parses the command’s pipelines, and we apply the same classifier to the public DCI-Agent-Lite trajectories (789 queries) and to ours. A command that runs Python is Python Scripting . Otherwise, a command with wc or with a search that counts matches is Aggregation/Counting , a pipeline with two or more searches is Chain Search , a search with a match limit or followed by head or tail is Search + Limit , and any other search with rg or grep is Single Keyword Search . A command with find , rg --files or a search over a file listing is Locate File , a single cat is Full Document Read , ls or pwd is List Directory , and all other commands are Other . We merge the categories into Python ( Python Scripting ), search ( Search + Limit , Chain Search and Single Keyword Search ) and other (the remaining five). We compare the public trajectories of DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) with GPT-5.4-nano on 789 BrowseComp-Plus queries ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , DKGI in Pi with GPT-6-Luna with the rg prompt and with our tool instruction on the same 450 validation queries (Appendix B.2 ), and Full DKGI in Pi with GPT-6-Luna on the full test sets (7,108 queries, 60,032 shell commands). These counts cover shell commands, which exclude calls of Pi’s read tool. Python commands make up 3.9% of the shell commands of DCI-Agent-Lite, 1.5% and 50.8% with the rg prompt and our tool instruction, and 47.6% for Full DKGI. Per dataset, 55.6%, 41.5% and 48.8% of the shell commands of Full DKGI run Python on Amazon, MAG and Prime. To locate a call in its trajectory, we divide the n n calls of a query, including read calls, into five equal segments, so that the i i -th call, counting from 0, lies in segment ⌊ 5 ​ i / n ⌋ + 1 \lfloor 5i/n\rfloor+1 . Over the calls of all queries, read and other calls make up the largest share in the first segment, rg calls in the second and Python calls in each later segment, with both models (Figure 2 a for GPT-6-Luna).
paragraphs.zh: 命令意图与轨迹分段。我们将每个 shell 命令分配给 Li et al. (2026) 在 DCI-Agent-Lite 中使用的九种类别之一，具体通过一个基于规则的分类器解析命令的流程；同时，我们将同一分类器应用于公开的 DCI-Agent-Lite 轨迹（789 条查询）以及我们自己的数据。运行 Python 的命令属于“Python 脚本编写”类别。否则，包含 wc 或用于统计匹配次数的搜索命令属于“聚合/计数”类别；包含两个或更多搜索步骤的流程属于“链式搜索”类别；带有匹配限制或接有 head 或 tail 的搜索命令属于“搜索 + 限制”类别；任何其他使用 rg 或 grep 的搜索命令则属于“单关键词搜索”类别。包含 find、rg --files 或对文件列表执行搜索的命令属于“定位文件”类别；单独的 cat 命令属于“完整文档读取”；ls 或 pwd 属于“列出目录”；所有其他命令则归为“其他”。我们将这些类别合并为 Python（Python 脚本编写）、搜索（搜索 + 限制、链式搜索和单关键词搜索）和其他（其余五类）。我们将 DCI-Agent-Lite 的公开轨迹（Li et al., 2026）与 GPT-5.4-nano 在 789 条 BrowseComp-Plus 查询（Chen et al., 2026）上的表现进行比较；将 Pi 中的 DKGI 与 GPT-6-Luna 在相同 450 条验证查询（附录 B.2）上，分别使用 rg 提示词和我们的工具指令进行比较；并将 Pi 中的完整 DKGI 与 GPT-6-Luna 在完整的测试集（7,108 条查询，60,032 个 shell 命令）上进行比较。这些统计量涵盖了 shell 命令，但不包括对 Pi 的 read 工具的调用。Python 命令占 DCI-Agent-Lite 所有 shell 命令的 3.9%；在使用 rg 提示词和我们的工具指令时，这一比例分别为 1.5% 和 50.8%；而在完整 DKGI 中，该比例为 47.6%。在每个数据集中，完整 DKGI 的 shell 命令中，有 55.6%、41.5% 和 48.8% 在 Amazon、MAG 和 Prime 上运行了 Python。为了在轨迹中定位某个调用，我们将一条查询中的 n 个调用（包括 read 调用）均分为五段，这样从 0 开始计数的第 i 个调用就位于第 ⌊5i/n⌋ + 1 段中。在所有查询的调用中，read 调用和其他调用在第一段中占比最大；rg 调用在第二段中最多；而 Python 调用则分布在后续每一段中，两种模型均如此（GPT-6-Luna 见图 2a）。

paragraphs.en: Python commands and edge files. A Python command is a shell call that runs python3 . It refers to edge files if its code or arguments mention the edge directory or an edge file. With GPT-6-Luna, 41.1% of the Python commands refer to edge files.

paragraphs.en: Revisions. The similarity of two programs is the ratio that Python’s difflib.SequenceMatcher computes for their first 4,000 characters. Before comparing, we remove boilerplate lines: imports, comments, path constants, loops over node shards or over the lines of a file, json.loads of a line, and try / except - continue lines. A program is counted as revising an earlier program in its trajectory if its similarity to the most similar earlier program is at least 0.5. This holds for 36.5% / 33.7% of the programs. With each model, in 99.7% of the revisions the program being revised was issued in an earlier turn, so its output was visible when the revision was written.
paragraphs.zh: 修订。 两个程序的相似度是 Python 的 difflib.SequenceMatcher 对其前 4000 个字符计算出的比率。 在比较之前，我们会移除模板代码行：导入语句、注释、路径常量、对节点分片或文件行的循环、对某一行执行 json.loads 的操作，以及 try / except - continue 行。 如果一个程序与其最相似的早期程序之间的相似度至少为 0.5，则它被视为对其轨迹中更早的程序进行了修订。 这一情况适用于 36.5% / 33.7% 的程序。 对于每个模型，在 99.7% 的修订案例中，被修订的程序是在更早的回合中生成的，因此当撰写修订内容时，其输出是可见的。

paragraphs.en: IDs from earlier outputs. A program contains an ID from an earlier output if its text contains a 4- to 8-digit integer that an output of an earlier turn showed as the ID of a node record, in an edge row, as a list element or at the start of a line. Years, multiples of 1,000 and numbers that appear in the prompt are excluded. This holds for 48.4% / 59.9% of the programs, and 83.1% / 95.9% of the queries with Python have such a program.

paragraphs.en: Operation types. We label each program by rules over its source code, and a program can have several labels. A full node scan iterates over all node files. A one-hop traversal reads an edge file, and a multi-hop traversal filters an edge file by IDs that an earlier edge filter of the same program returned, or expands an adjacency index from a loop over seed nodes. Each program that reads an edge file gets one of these two traversal labels. The set operations label covers intersections and differences of ID sets. Scoring or ranking sorts candidates, keeps the top ones or accumulates scores or counts. A check of earlier IDs contains an ID from an earlier output, as defined above, and looks it up in the node files, the edge files or the list of candidates. Two of these types, the one-hop traversal and the check of earlier IDs, have counterparts among the predefined graph tools (Table 5 ). neighbors performs a one-hop traversal, and get_node looks up a known ID, as a check of earlier IDs does. The closest counterpart of a full node scan is search , which returns the k ≤ 30 k\leq 30 best BM25 matches for a query. The other three types can require several calls or code.
paragraphs.zh: 操作类型。 我们通过针对源代码的规则为每个程序添加标签，一个程序可以拥有多个标签。 完整的节点扫描会遍历所有节点文件。 单跳遍历读取一条边文件，而多跳遍历则根据同一程序早期边过滤器返回的 ID 对边文件进行过滤，或者通过对种子节点的循环来扩展邻接索引。 每个读取边文件的程序都会获得这两种遍历标签之一。 集合操作标签涵盖了 ID 集合的交集和差集。 评分或排名会排序候选项，保留排名靠前的项，或累积分数或计数。 早期 ID 的检查包含来自早期输出的一个 ID（如上文所定义），并在节点文件、边文件或候选项列表中查找该 ID。 其中两种类型——单跳遍历和早期 ID 的检查——在预定义的图工具（表 5）中有对应项：neighbors 执行单跳遍历，而 get_node 则像早期 ID 的检查一样查找已知 ID。 完整节点扫描最接近的对应工具是 search，它能根据查询返回 k ≤ 30 个最佳 BM25 匹配结果。 其余三种类型可能需要多次调用或额外的代码。

paragraphs.en: Failures and the next program. A program fails if it exits with a non-zero status, prints a Python traceback or syntax error, or times out. The 164 / 66 programs with an interpreter start error are excluded from both the failures and the successes. Of the programs that ran, 7.4% / 8.5% failed (2,089 / 2,426). The next program after a given program is the first program issued in a later turn. It is counted as revising the given program if their similarity, computed as above but with the boilerplate lines kept, is at least 0.5. Section 3.4 and Table 9 use the 2,033 / 2,395 failed and 19,534 / 19,369 successful programs that have a next program. In 85.6% / 91.1% of these failures, the next program revises the failed one and runs successfully.
paragraphs.zh: 失败与下一个程序。 如果一个程序以非零状态退出、输出 Python 堆栈跟踪或语法错误，或者超时，则视为失败。 出现解释器启动错误的 164 / 66 个程序被排除在失败和成功程序之外。 在已运行的程序中，有 7.4% / 8.5% 的程序失败（2,089 / 2,426）。 给定程序之后的下一个程序，是后续轮次中执行的第一条程序。 如果它们的相似度（按上述方法计算，但保留模板行）至少为 0.5，则被视为对给定程序的修订。 第 3.4 节和表 9 使用了那些有下一个程序的 2,033 / 2,395 个失败程序和 19,534 / 19,369 个成功程序。 在这些失败中，有 85.6% / 91.1% 的情况，下一个程序对失败程序进行了修订并成功运行。

paragraphs.en: Lineages and gold IDs in outputs. We link each program to the most similar program issued before it in the same query if their similarity, computed with the boilerplate lines kept, is at least 0.5. The programs connected by these links form a lineage , whose first and last versions are its earliest and latest programs. There are 7,282 / 7,621 lineages with at least two versions. A call shows a gold ID if its output that the model saw contains the ID of a gold node as a standalone number. For the first and last versions of the lineages, this holds for 40.0% / 49.4% of the first versions and 72.0% / 67.9% of the last versions. The test accepts the ID in any position of the output. Over the 5,080 queries that GPT-6-Luna answers correctly, the first call that shows a gold ID is a program in 68.5%, an rg search in 29.7% and another command in 1.8%, while programs make up 38.2% of all calls, read calls included. The error analysis of Appendix H uses a stricter test that requires the node’s record or its record header.
paragraphs.zh: 输出中的谱系和黄金 ID。 如果保留模板行后计算出的相似度至少为 0.5，我们会将每个程序与同一查询中在它之前发布的最相似程序关联起来。 通过这些链接连接起来的程序构成一个谱系，其第一个和最后一个版本分别是该谱系的最早程序和最新程序。 有 7,282 / 7,621 个谱系至少包含两个版本。 如果模型所见的输出中包含黄金节点的 ID 作为一个独立的数字，则一次调用会显示黄金 ID。 对于谱系的第一个和最后一个版本，这一情况分别适用于 40.0% / 49.4% 的第一个版本和 72.0% / 67.9% 的最后一个版本。 该测试接受输出中任何位置的 ID。 在 GPT-6-Luna 正确回答的 5,080 个查询中，首次显示黄金 ID 的调用中，68.5% 是程序，29.7% 是 rg 搜索，1.8% 是其他命令；而包括读取调用在内，程序占所有调用的 38.2%。 附录 H 中的错误分析使用了一种更严格的测试，要求必须包含该节点的记录或其记录标题。

paragraphs.en: Truncated outputs and the next turn. An rg call is a shell call that runs rg or grep as a search, excluding file listings and calls that also run Python. We use the successful rg calls that are followed by another turn. An output is truncated if head-and-tail truncation (§ 2.4 ) shortens it, and the outcome is whether the next turn runs a Python program. The model sees at least 14.8 KB / 16.4 KB of every truncated output, so we compare the 9,475 / 5,699 truncated outputs with the 1,577 / 2,169 untruncated outputs of at least 4 KB. Because truncated and untruncated calls occur at different points of a trajectory, we compare them within each of the five trajectory segments, weight the segments by their number of truncated calls and drop segments with fewer than 20 calls on either side, which removes the first segment with GPT-6-Luna. With both models, the next turn runs Python more often after a truncated output than after an untruncated one of at least 4 KB (66.8% vs. 59.3% with GPT-6-Luna and 76.1% vs. 40.1% with GPT-6-Astra, Table 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 截断的输出与下一轮。 rg 调用是一种运行 rg 或 grep 进行搜索的 shell 调用，不包括文件列表以及同时运行 Python 的调用。 我们使用那些之后还有一轮操作的成功 rg 调用。 如果头尾截断（§ 2.4）缩短了输出，则该输出被视为截断的；其结果取决于下一轮是否运行 Python 程序。 模型能看到每个截断输出的至少 14.8 KB / 16.4 KB 内容，因此我们将 9,475 / 5,699 个截断输出与至少 4 KB 的 1,577 / 2,169 个非截断输出进行比较。 由于截断调用和非截断调用发生在轨迹的不同阶段，我们在五个轨迹分段内分别进行比较，按各分段的截断调用数量进行加权，并剔除两侧调用数少于 20 次的分段，这导致使用 GPT-6-Luna 的第一个分段被排除。 对于两种模型，在截断输出之后，下一轮运行 Python 的概率高于非截断且至少为 4 KB 的输出之后（GPT-6-Luna 为 66.8% vs. 59.3%，GPT-6-Astra 为 76.1% vs. 40.1%，见表 9）。

paragraphs.en: Text-constraint tags. GPT-6-Luna, run with reasoning effort high , labels each query from two inputs, the query text and the names of the node and relation types. A query has a text constraint if checking one of its requirements needs a node’s own text. The LLM annotator tags 96% of the Amazon and 57% of the Prime queries as having an additional text constraint. We treat all MAG queries as text-constrained based on their topic descriptions. On Amazon, H@1 is 8.1 points higher on text-constrained queries than on the 60 relation-only queries, and on Prime it is 2.1 points lower.
paragraphs.zh: 文本约束标签。 GPT-6-Luna 在高推理努力下运行，对每个来自两个输入（查询文本以及节点和关系类型的名称）的查询进行标记。 如果检查查询的某个要求需要节点的自身文本，则该查询具有文本约束。 LLM 标注器将 96% 的 Amazon 查询和 57% 的 Prime 查询标记为具有额外的文本约束。 我们根据主题描述将所有 MAG 查询视为具有文本约束。 在 Amazon 上，文本约束查询的 H@1 比仅包含关系的 60 个查询高 8.1 分，而在 Prime 上则低 2.1 分。

paragraphs.en: We assign every query that Full DKGI in Pi answers incorrectly on the full test sets (7,108 queries per backbone) to one of four categories, using the outputs as the model saw them. A query is an empty answer if the run ends in a failure, in output other than the requested JSON object or in an empty list. Otherwise, it is a ranking error if a gold node is returned at rank 2 or lower, a selection error if an output that the model saw showed a gold record and the returned list misses every gold node, and a search miss in all remaining cases. An output shows a gold record if it contains the node’s record ( "node_id": <id> ) or the ID alone in square brackets ( [<id>] ), as in a record header. IDs in other positions, for example in edge rows, are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Full DKGI 在 Pi 的完整测试集上回答错误的每个查询（每个骨干模型有 7,108 个查询）归入四个类别之一，依据是模型实际看到的输出。 如果运行以失败告终，或者输出不是所请求的 JSON 对象而是其他内容，或者是一个空列表，则该查询被视为无答案。 否则，如果黄金节点出现在第 2 位或更低排名，则为排序错误；如果模型看到的结果中包含了黄金记录，但返回的列表中缺少所有黄金节点，则为选择错误；其余所有情况均视为搜索遗漏。 如果输出包含该节点的记录（"node_id": <id>）或仅包含方括号内的 ID（[<id>]），就像记录标题中的那样，则视为展示了黄金记录。 其他位置出现的 ID，例如边行中的 ID，则不计入其中。

paragraphs.en: Ranking errors are the largest category on every dataset with both backbones and make up 55% of the errors overall with GPT-6-Luna and 60% with GPT-6-Astra (Table 10 ). In these queries, the agent has found a gold node and returned it below the first position, so a gold node is found in more queries than H@1 shows. With the stronger GPT-6-Astra, search misses make up 24% of the errors overall, compared with 36% with GPT-6-Luna, and empty answers make up 1% of the errors overall with both backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有数据集中，排名错误都是最大的错误类别，无论使用哪种基础模型；在 GPT-6-Luna 中，这类错误占总体错误的 55%，而在 GPT-6-Astra 中则占 60%（表 10）。 在这些查询中，智能体已经找到了一个黄金节点，并将其排在首位之后，因此被找到的黄金节点数量比 H@1 指标所显示的要多。 在性能更强的 GPT-6-Astra 中，搜索失败占总体错误的 24%，而 GPT-6-Luna 中这一比例为 36%；两种基础模型中，空白回答均占总体错误的 1%。

paragraphs.en: We compare Full DKGI with Graph tools on three requests from the 710-query test subset, one from each dataset. On each of them, Full DKGI ranks a gold node first and Graph tools ranks another node first. Table 11 lists the outcome and the number of calls of every configuration except One program on these requests. Each case gives the request and its gold answers, an excerpt of each trajectory with GPT-6-Luna, and a comparison of the operation that the agent writes with the calls that the graph tools of Table 5 provide.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 710 次查询测试子集中选取的三个请求（每个数据集各一个）上，将 Full DKGI 与 Graph tools 进行了比较。 在这三个请求中，Full DKGI 都将一个黄金节点排在首位，而 Graph tools 则将另一个节点排在首位。 表 11 列出了除 One program 之外的所有配置在这些请求上的结果以及调用次数。 每个案例都给出了请求及其黄金答案、使用 GPT-6-Luna 生成的每条轨迹的片段，以及对智能体所编写的操作与表 5 中图工具所提供的调用之间的比较。

paragraphs.en: Graph tools. The agent finds the institution and the field Data quality with search . Its neighbors call on the institution lists 20 of the 66 affiliated authors (call 6), and two of these 20 authors are co-authors of the gold paper. Its neighbors call on the field lists 20 of the 86 papers in the field (call 11). paragraphs.en: Full DKGI. The first program (call 11) has a silent bug. Each edge line still ends in its newline character, so the membership test fails on every line, and the program prints the two file names. After printing the file headers (call 12), the agent revises the program (call 13). The next program is a two-hop traversal from the institution through its 66 authors to their 236 papers, and it reads the node shards that hold these papers (call 14). Call 15 adds the topic relation and an intersection, with the field ID shown by the rg search of call 9, and the intersection holds one paper, the gold paper. Call 19 rewrites the same traversal more compactly to rank the candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 DKGI。 第一个程序（调用 11）存在一个静默错误。 每条边线仍然以换行符结尾，因此成员资格测试在每一行都会失败，程序会输出两个文件名。 在打印文件标题（调用 12）后，智能体修改了程序（调用 13）。 下一个程序是从机构出发，经过其 66 位作者到他们 236 篇论文的双跳遍历，并读取存储这些论文的节点分片（调用 14）。 调用 15 添加了主题关系和一个交集，其中字段 ID 由调用 9 的 rg 搜索显示，该交集包含一篇论文，即目标论文。 调用 19 以更紧凑的方式重写了相同的遍历过程，以便对候选项进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Comparison. The agent writes the request as a traversal over three relations, from the institution to its authors, from the authors to their papers and from the field to its papers, followed by an intersection of the two sets of papers. With the predefined graph tools, each hop of this traversal is a neighbors call from a single node that lists up to 20 neighbors and the total number found, and Graph tools makes one such call for each author or paper that it examines.
paragraphs.zh: 比较。 该智能体将请求写成一个遍历三种关系的过程：从机构到其作者，从作者到他们的论文，以及从领域到其论文，然后对这两组论文进行交集运算。 借助预定义的图工具，此遍历的每一步都是一个单一节点的邻居调用，该调用会列出最多 20 个邻居及其总数；对于每个被检查的作者或论文，图工具都会执行一次这样的调用。

sents.zh: 比较。

In the edge files, relation 16 is expression present and relation 17 expression absent .

paragraphs.en: Graph tools. The agent lists the 13 pericardium genes with one neighbors call (call 5). Its requests for expression absent edges go to the pericardium and to the nodes dorsal thalamus and ventral thalamus , and all three return empty results (calls 8, 10 and 11). It then tests the genes one at a time, with a get_node call for each gene (calls 12–24) and, for 12 of them, a neighbors call on dorsal plus ventral thalamus that is restricted to expression present and to the gene’s name (calls 25–36). It returns the four genes that this test leaves, PDLIM3, TCAP, ADH1B and ITLN1, in this order.
paragraphs.zh: 图工具。 该智能体通过一次邻居调用（调用 5）列出了 13 个心包基因。 它针对不存在表达边的请求被发送到心包以及背侧丘脑和腹侧丘脑节点，但三者均返回空结果（调用 8、10 和 11）。 接着，它逐个测试这些基因，对每个基因都执行一次 get_node 调用（调用 12–24），并对其中 12 个基因在背侧丘脑和腹侧丘脑上执行邻居调用，该调用仅限于表达存在且与基因名称相关（调用 25–36）。 它按此顺序返回此次测试留下的四个基因：PDLIM3、TCAP、ADH1B 和 ITLN1。

paragraphs.en: Full DKGI. After a scan of the node records for the anatomy nodes of the request (call 5), the agent writes one program over both relations (call 12). It intersects the 13 pericardium genes, whose IDs it copies from the output of call 11, with the expression present and expression absent neighbors of seven thalamus nodes. The output shows nine genes with an expression present edge to dorsal plus ventral thalamus and ADH1B with an expression absent edge to it. The agent returns the four remaining genes and ranks ADH1B first.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 DKGI。 在扫描节点记录以获取请求（调用 5）的解剖学节点后，智能体针对两个关系编写了一个程序（调用 12）。 它与 13 个心包基因（其 ID 是从调用 11 的输出中复制的）以及七个丘脑节点的“表达存在”和“表达缺失”邻居进行交叉。 输出显示有九个基因与背侧和腹侧丘脑存在“表达存在”边，而 ADH1B 则与之存在“表达缺失”边。 智能体返回了其余的四个基因，并将 ADH1B 排在首位。

paragraphs.en: Comparison. The agent’s program performs set algebra over two relations. In one run, it intersects a set of genes with the neighbors of seven anatomy nodes under both relations, and the agent takes the difference from the printed intersections. With the predefined graph tools, each test covers one node, one relation and, through query , one gene name, and Graph tools spends 25 calls on the 13 genes.
paragraphs.zh: 比较。 智能体的程序对两个关系执行集合代数运算。 在一次运行中，它在一个基因集合与两种关系下七个解剖学节点的邻居之间求交集，然后智能体从打印出的交集中取差集。 借助预定义的图工具，每次测试涵盖一个节点、一种关系以及通过查询确定的一个基因名称，而图工具在这13个基因上消耗了25次调用。

paragraphs.en: Full DKGI. The first program fails because \n is written literally inside the single-quoted argument of python3 -c (call 6). The next call passes the same code (similarity 0.99) inside $’...’ quotes, and this program runs (call 7). Each of the next four programs (calls 8, 9, 10 and 12) follows a truncated output that lists unrelated products (“Tagless collars”, key chains, domino sets in metal tins) and narrows the filter. The last program looks up the titles of the 27 IDs that the previous output listed (call 13), and the agent returns the 18 gold products at ranks 1 to 18.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 DKGI。 第一个程序失败，因为在 python3 -c（调用 6）的单引号参数中，\n 被作为字面量写入。 下一个调用将相同的代码（相似度 0.99）放入 $’...’ 引号中，此时该程序可以运行（调用 7）。 接下来的四个程序（调用 8、9、10 和 12）都遵循一种截断输出的模式：先列出无关的产品（“无标签项圈”、钥匙扣、金属罐中的多米诺骨牌套装），然后逐步缩小筛选范围。 最后一个程序查找了前一个输出所列出的 27 个 ID 的标题（调用 13），智能体返回了排名第 1 到第 18 位的 18 款黄金产品。

paragraphs.en: Comparison. The agent’s tool is a filter over the title, features and description of every product record, and the agent narrows it four times after truncated outputs. The predefined graph tools provide a BM25 search over node names and summaries and get_node , which returns one complete record per call, with the reviews before the title.
paragraphs.zh: 比较。 智能体的工具是对每个产品记录的标题、特征和描述进行过滤，并且在截断输出后，智能体会将其范围缩小四次。 预定义的图工具提供基于节点名称和摘要的 BM25 搜索功能，以及 get_node 方法；每次调用会返回一条完整记录，且评论位于标题之前。
